body:
Years ago, I volunteered to serve in our nation's military, and nothing could shake the indescribable sense of pride I gained from those years. I was called to serve, and I will never stop.
---
| | | | | | [Unsubscribe](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_s=94ee672865b14cfe9dee887531a4bae1&_t=RLWAJvQXPDNjx96wZ8i1aE9nlY_N8s4MdSs6WwZMtJBVYUA9-iiwdWCniOs6cj-KZRiiHVr0eVPDc3gAPOk0d6dHhKrjNkDThrZ_GlP6iuE%3D) | [Mark as Junk](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_s=94ee672865b14cfe9dee887531a4bae1&_t=RLWAJvQXPDNjx96wZ8i1aE9nlY_N8s4MdSs6WwZMtJBVYUA9-iiwdWCniOs6cj-KZRiiHVr0eVPDc3gAPOk0d6dHhKrjNkDThrZ_GlP6iuE%3D)

---
Peter, If you've heard my story, you know that I went from being a blue-collar kid in Florida, to attending Yale on a baseball scholarship, to working my way through Harvard Law School... all leading up to the day I saw our freedom come under fire on September 11th, 2001, and volunteering to serve in the proudest fighting force in the world. When I deployed to Iraq with U.S. Navy SEAL Team One, I put on the cloth of my country, shipped out with a sense of confidence, conviction, and patriotic duty to our nation, _and served with undying honor._ Fighting for this country has always been personal to me, and I will hold that honor close to my chest for as long as I live.
---
| [](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=94ee672865b14cfe9dee887531a4bae1&_e=SHeAWzrVxc_IVTmntLFHGAoz-3IOy2SFPDri7j3Bmdwv2MbzXJs4QHIEpQsnklYX7vhPEuZXDl91qsRideeqaYjF6ana1M5GQKQm3AxMMm7YsOtm8cdUerwUd2oTwRn8jr9WL3pozhqrNkaFKlWQ15RzTPudl_cIDoekLIaItltb5ohTWeHbpwo6jKQMM6Xg53H2dcWsBhDnAuqD-ogEhWkQ_tVPpR02vf_Cj-gPP-4zD38XQIgtHsRPbYPi-gycnoGILH9TlbyGnyi5ohdydsKQCpcre0Q-lOHPeA36k1Ohh8qzlzBqBIPHvzQTK4kT6eZtNv8ghx9G7dIwDoqaU8d17_D2-Bp0gnP5cQW2mb4HMsHyVmuT1vuIDzhXnjGT_uJ3U4ULUlkpJmf11E0nQs8YX3O2BtCklrbVYoD9hOezWvSw4b4toic7n2xCBccC)
---
As the only veteran in this race, I feel a responsibility to step up and lead with the conviction I'll never shake from my time in the service. I believe our country deserves a Commander-in-Chief who truly understands what we're fighting for and what we're fighting against. _The gravity of the situation we're now facing is nothing short of_** _dire_** _._ Our nation's once-proud fighting force has been infected and paralyzed by a political agenda, our military recruitment levels have reached an all-time low, and yet we are expected to salute our "Commander-in-Chief," Joe Biden. Not only is this a slap in the face to the veterans across this country, but it is an insult to _every_ soldier who has come before our time:
* Those 56 men who pledged their lives in Independence Hall in 1776 so that they could create a new nation conceived in liberty.

* Our nation's first Republican President who stood at a cemetery in Gettysburg and pledged this nation to a new birth of freedom.

* That band of brothers who stormed the beaches of Normandy, defeated the Nazis, and saved this world.

As a veteran, as a former Congressman, as Governor, and as a father, I have remained steadfast in my devotion to reminding those who will listen of the words of Ronald Reagan: **_Freedom is one generation away from extinction; it's not passed along in the bloodstream, and it must be protected and cultivated._** Today, I am humbly asking you for support to help me fire Joe Biden and restore**this mission and sanity, pride, integrity, and capability** to the chief office of our military.
---
| | [Support my campaign for President](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=94ee672865b14cfe9dee887531a4bae1&_e=SHeAWzrVxc_IVTmntLFHGAoz-3IOy2SFPDri7j3Bmdwv2MbzXJs4QHIEpQsnklYX7vhPEuZXDl91qsRideeqaYjF6ana1M5GQKQm3AxMMm7YsOtm8cdUerwUd2oTwRn8jr9WL3pozhqrNkaFKlWQ15RzTPudl_cIDoekLIaItltb5ohTWeHbpwo6jKQMM6Xg53H2dcWsBhDnAuqD-ogEhWkQ_tVPpR02vf_Cj-gPP-4zD38XQIgtHsRPbYPi-gycnoGILH9TlbyGnyi5ohdydsKQCpcre0Q-lOHPeA36k1P8o4YbnBHFTPzujjCEjNCNqq_tZqrV7AjVa5ixF9w1fobeZIKn_KEb4bKuNpuSv_jj9vMkt2V9wSHh05SmfuzgI6O0Iw0R56-3bN6z-a44HxqWbxZxoUZpDEXBlPABgVTK812n28EGkiFOj-C6aalm)

And Peter, I am also asking you for one more thing. Please, as our freedoms continue to come under fire every day that we allow Joe Biden to sit in our Oval Office, choose to stand on the side of freedom today, and always. I need you fighting with me.

Yours in Freedom,
---

Ron DeSantis

---
| | |
_**Get to Know Ron DeSantis**_
---
| | | [](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=94ee672865b14cfe9dee887531a4bae1&_e=SHeAWzrVxc_IVTmntLFHGAoz-3IOy2SFPDri7j3Bmdwv2MbzXJs4QHIEpQsnklYX7vhPEuZXDl91qsRideeqaYjF6ana1M5GQKQm3AxMMm7YsOtm8cdUerwUd2oTwRn8jr9WL3pozhqrNkaFKlWQ15RzTPudl_cIDoekLIaItltb5ohTWeHbpwo6jKQMM6Xg53H2dcWsBhDnAuqD-ogEhWkQ_tVPpR02vf_Cj-gPP-4zD38XQIgtHsRPbYPi-gycnoGILH9TlbyGnyi5ohdydsKQCpcre0Q-lOHPeA36k1M6Qy24vVchIFIfIHcR8gkjUdKcdezjVY22dPVawd5kMeWc_tc5qqPFy3Dqcuc53KcVTQetyAdvvaU5rjhTZKNS7kNtgFYuJ1kggicGg1T280ktFH6k5bi-89_fWoxN-Rwej0i9wl0OmYxXxlsccy8q)
---

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

---
| [](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=94ee672865b14cfe9dee887531a4bae1&_e=SHeAWzrVxc_IVTmntLFHGAoz-3IOy2SFPDri7j3Bmdwv2MbzXJs4QHIEpQsnklYX7vhPEuZXDl91qsRideeqaYjF6ana1M5GQKQm3AxMMm7YsOtm8cdUerwUd2oTwRn8jr9WL3pozhqrNkaFKlWQ15RzTPudl_cIDoekLIaItltb5ohTWeHbpwo6jKQMM6Xg53H2dcWsBhDnAuqD-ogEhWkQ_tVPpR02vf_Cj-gPP-4zD38XQIgtHsRPbYPi-gycnoGILH9TlbyGnyi5ohdydsKQCpcre0Q-lOHPeA36k1NGXzAfsAjwSquw9gaxzFl83CNc4ISXJQdVBCH0OZ6s-k14ktwgzz1sNmW1XHXUTj5Y2FLPp8rtrYrLfpH-TXyeVCYpZa_nWK-LlOqVuhYw5zUwB9vuVI07wYmdZFsvoUlPeAfWLfIiShLD7IVPYUsI)
---

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

name: Gene Karpinski, LCV
subject: This is BAD, Peter: Anti-environment riders attached to a must-pass budget bill.
body:
Time sensitive

Peter - our Membership Drive deadline is a few days away, and we're reaching out because we haven't heard from you yet (renew your membership here and your contribution will be tripled https://links.messages.lcv. ).

The truth is your membership matters, and it's particularly critical right now.

Here's the situation: Earlier this month, Senator Joe Manchin backed away from a climate deal after months of negotiations, choosing to side with Big Oil and Republicans. It leaves the deal one vote short -- stalling any real action in Congress for now.

In response, we're redoubling our efforts on pushing the White House to act decisively on climate. The Biden administration has massive amounts of power to curb climate pollution - but that will only happen if the environmental movement makes it happen.

Right now, we're facing a critical test: the Biden administration is weighing a plan to block all new oil and gas drilling leases on public waters.

This could be huge -- and a decision is coming. Right now, we're organizing volunteers from all over the country to flood the administration with letters, pressuring Biden to hold to his promises.

Peter -- it's your membership support that makes victory possible here. But we have to do more. A group of donors has put together a fund to triple match every contribution before Sunday's membership deadline:

Can we count on your support? Claim your membership now - it only takes $5 >> https://links.messages.lcv.

The ban on new oil and gas leases is the first of many huge environmental decisions, Peter. And right now, we're pushing for serious action on so many fronts -- including:
Setting tight standards for power plants and other major emitters of climate pollution
Placing strict limits on air pollution to safeguard all communities Expediting requirements of 100% tailpipe pollution-free new cars by 2035 and trucks by 2040
Protecting communities from hazardous and super-polluting methane Conserving 30% of our public lands and waters by 2030 Declaring a climate emergency - and so much more. The best way you can help win each and every one of these fights right now is to claim your LCV membership - all it takes is a gift of $5 or more. https://links.messages.lcv.

Thank you, thank you, thank you, Peter. This is such a critical moment for the environment, and we're so fortunate to have you on the team.

Onward,

Gene Karpinski
President
League of Conservation Voters

Fellow Conservative, If you've heard my story, you know that I went from being a blue-collar kid in Florida, to attending Yale on a baseball scholarship, to working my way through Harvard Law School... all leading up to the day I saw our freedom come under fire on September 11th, 2001, and volunteering to serve in the proudest fighting force in the world. When I deployed to Iraq with U.S. Navy SEAL Team One, I put on the cloth of my country, shipped out with a sense of confidence, conviction, and patriotic duty to our nation, _and served with undying honor._ Fighting for this country has always been personal to me, and I will hold that honor close to my chest for as long as I live.

As the only veteran in this race, I feel a responsibility to step up and lead with the conviction I'll never shake from my time in the service. I believe our country deserves a Commander-in-Chief who truly understands what we're fighting for and what we're fighting against. _The gravity of the situation we're now facing is nothing short of_** _dire_** _._ Our nation's once-proud fighting force has been infected and paralyzed by a political agenda, our military recruitment levels have reached an all-time low, and yet we are expected to salute our "Commander-in-Chief," Joe Biden. Not only is this a slap in the face to the veterans across this country, but it is an insult to _every_ soldier who has come before our time:
* Those 56 men who pledged their lives in Independence Hall in 1776 so that they could create a new nation conceived in liberty.

* Our nation's first Republican President who stood at a cemetery in Gettysburg and pledged this nation to a new birth of freedom.

* That band of brothers who stormed the beaches of Normandy, defeated the Nazis, and saved this world.

As a veteran, as a former Congressman, as Governor, and as a father, I have remained steadfast in my devotion to reminding those who will listen of the words of Ronald Reagan: **_Freedom is one generation away from extinction; it's not passed along in the bloodstream, and it must be protected and cultivated._** Today, I am humbly asking you for support to help me fire Joe Biden and restore**this mission and sanity, pride, integrity, and capability** to the chief office of our military.

He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Peter, If you've heard my story, you know that I went from being a blue-collar kid in Florida, to attending Yale on a baseball scholarship, to working my way through Harvard Law School... all leading up to the day I saw our freedom come under fire on September 11th, 2001, and volunteering to serve in the proudest fighting force in the world. When I deployed to Iraq with U.S. Navy SEAL Team One, I put on the cloth of my country, shipped out with a sense of confidence, conviction, and patriotic duty to our nation, _and served with undying honor._ Fighting for this country has always been personal to me, and I will hold that honor close to my chest for as long as I live.
---
| [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=86b4416a28bd49d0b60c7c9fc93f27e5&_e=IabXI8v61cINPtYMNrgVArbbzSSM1AMDJQRb66aTa9rDL2pjJCIQREQDcgGfM6ImiMdCEk7wUPSKajSDxn0TsWcA3cgDOkuken3QLjjCG_pJkMpyb0UFsTlqXax_l-C8i6F4otoJ9-wYvsYrvoV12tuFDNTHnmG7rmWhr-Pw2a5JzV3HHWovr9cV7KsE4TumsfJz6aPsiLhJC442C9-yzN1CGon8rqVyYAzGrnQwfi_yqyvB7NYkrW5-PU491B4hMKSqjkVhgleal5mpw-E-s83BMkC7LL5Ozovk5hkDz7cFMES6vVtKBKsMPBZG3wMDlwFTzmYx-YRPOVzTIvD5LZFS7a9WosSaW2wooYhcbZLPb-NVV0TaPsNY59fXkQrbuYHegQxruXoJRB6GcgpzUXx9sQepBAJR1vIzWRy3e25kjg57yR_94id5bHyecsA8)
---
As the only veteran in this race, I feel a responsibility to step up and lead with the conviction I'll never shake from my time in the service. I believe our country deserves a Commander-in-Chief who truly understands what we're fighting for and what we're fighting against. _The gravity of the situation we're now facing is nothing short of_** _dire_** _._ Our nation's once-proud fighting force has been infected and paralyzed by a political agenda, our military recruitment levels have reached an all-time low, and yet we are expected to salute our "Commander-in-Chief," Joe Biden. Not only is this a slap in the face to the veterans across this country, but it is an insult to _every_ soldier who has come before our time:
* Those 56 men who pledged their lives in Independence Hall in 1776 so that they could create a new nation conceived in liberty.

* Our nation's first Republican President who stood at a cemetery in Gettysburg and pledged this nation to a new birth of freedom.

* That band of brothers who stormed the beaches of Normandy, defeated the Nazis, and saved this world.

As a veteran, as a former Congressman, as Governor, and as a father, I have remained steadfast in my devotion to reminding those who will listen of the words of Ronald Reagan: **_Freedom is one generation away from extinction; it's not passed along in the bloodstream, and it must be protected and cultivated._** Today, I am humbly asking you for support to help me fire Joe Biden and restore**this mission and sanity, pride, integrity, and capability** to the chief office of our military.
---

Yours in Freedom,

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

---

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

When I saw everything that we’d worked for in Afghanistan washed away in a matter of days, I decided to consider serving in government once again | [Unsubscribe](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_s=bb4f5566ac074c4ca4b99640d8418fa0&_t=SXy4uY7Je0XUU1gNu562bVWF0_pNHiDuya7ElR25g50rwP365VtB82lylkZ4AG7VgHlmYUQBMSVnP0_kZIXsP4MUuHOZc0EQEyP7R2DFc-M%3D) | [Mark as Junk](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_s=bb4f5566ac074c4ca4b99640d8418fa0&_t=SXy4uY7Je0XUU1gNu562bVWF0_pNHiDuya7ElR25g50rwP365VtB82lylkZ4AG7VgHlmYUQBMSVnP0_kZIXsP4MUuHOZc0EQEyP7R2DFc-M%3D)

[](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=bb4f5566ac074c4ca4b99640d8418fa0&_e=-h8RxeyruYXvKhpvavt5_3620Zk7xT6_htskeButBfu3r39VpDcVlMMC0PrcF_eMsNkM7BUlPvVLZhWyduGuhCcb15rcqLPPbESAHmNa7rAHA8d5ASpoNPpm80pFI2iaFDeFBFlCeg1ije_xac2RRaxzwdv8oZpE2LEYGdc-5b13tpfnqqBGcu4nj7_UV_ZtAdhiMf0jzXuX7-gW8VmdSA88WEXgluK8FG4vbGGH3xupfCWm2GdVDQcPG4Zl5qASOq6g3YNP52zwO6KN0jilie7g6AFuDKVOOfHYxbIwGHfhhHwvF-KJ-dxZzCIBD-U21SbjziIs19-7yhg-6424RJ89bIKA2aTiwN9eHQBrR1OlH1QiX-zxEo2LYogYKQtWxFgfy049jhZkLcuVpwNGg94MgvQOZeHCO4guJS89nCulIRipd73GFQVXaOCmMvmi)

Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate this past June.](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=bb4f5566ac074c4ca4b99640d8418fa0&_e=-h8RxeyruYXvKhpvavt5_3620Zk7xT6_htskeButBfu3r39VpDcVlMMC0PrcF_eMsNkM7BUlPvVLZhWyduGuhCcb15rcqLPPbESAHmNa7rAHA8d5ASpoNPpm80pFI2iaFDeFBFlCeg1ije_xac2RRaxzwdv8oZpE2LEYGdc-5b13tpfnqqBGcu4nj7_UV_ZtAdhiMf0jzXuX7-gW8VmdSA88WEXgluK8FG4vbGGH3xupfCWm2GdVDQcPG4Zl5qASOq6g3YNP52zwO6KN0jiliVqr6IMrbvMu0_zKaD5-0peUqoYJx3wP3LKR2eTcqVP8dDvku463pKaygX_fxTntip6nTzMw5zDs7EhIGBfQ5RovIPoHBKcpYness0VVr0J63yEAE9rXrqRABqDcbrbpPmcKb3ir4J5eI269N9K2S-k-dn6oDAyKwCBkQGmsBSbJ)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=bb4f5566ac074c4ca4b99640d8418fa0&_e=-h8RxeyruYXvKhpvavt5_3620Zk7xT6_htskeButBfu3r39VpDcVlMMC0PrcF_eMsNkM7BUlPvVLZhWyduGuhCcb15rcqLPPbESAHmNa7rAHA8d5ASpoNPpm80pFI2iaFDeFBFlCeg1ije_xac2RRaxzwdv8oZpE2LEYGdc-5b13tpfnqqBGcu4nj7_UV_ZtAdhiMf0jzXuX7-gW8VmdSA88WEXgluK8FG4vbGGH3xupfCWm2GdVDQcPG4Zl5qASOq6g3YNP52zwO6KN0jilia7wKGnI4uSEzpBKE1oVKuICZwjSCUWHJcT-WFkdEJus3vosTiHP3TU_qVh0GD4MZ7WXSscymGJp0JpMxw63bFJaDrSj4sZXL9gDRMtp_I7u56heDCQAC5NdfJ5OxifarhdKBmxHNbemQGzX55TlQHRv-wHpecOGSk76nEE_i3SM)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I hate to be this blunt.

But I have to ask you, **__can you give me 12 months_?_**

With everything that’s at stake for the pro-life movement _(and our country!)_ in 2024, can I count on you to please sign up as a _Students for Life Action_ monthly contributor – __at least through November 2024_?_

I know I’ve asked you this before, Pro-Life Friend. But before you decide, please consider this . . .

We are now just **ONE YEAR AWAY** from Election Day 2024.

And just days ago, _The Hill_ reported something from the Biden campaign that made me sick – _something that I’m worried could give them a huge leg up if you and I don’t answer them_.

In an article discussing the massive fundraising haul that President Biden’s brought in during the third quarter, _The Hill_ bragged:

**“The Biden campaign announced it . . . has over 112,000 people who have committed to donating every month.”**
Pro-Life Friend, if the radical pro-abortion Left outpaces you and me on BOTH contributions from fat-cat donors and monthly contributors, **_I truly fear for the worst in 2024_.**

**[So, can I count on you to please sign up as a _Students for Life Action_ monthly contributor – even if it’s just for the next 12 months](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sjutjky-duchtdja-y/)?**

Years ago, I volunteered to serve in our nation's military, and nothing could shake the indescribable sense of pride I gained from those years. I was called to serve, and I will never stop.

Fellow Conservative, If you've heard my story, you know that I went from being a blue-collar kid in Florida, to attending Yale on a baseball scholarship, to working my way through Harvard Law School... all leading up to the day I saw our freedom come under fire on September 11th, 2001, and volunteering to serve in the proudest fighting force in the world. When I deployed to Iraq with U.S. Navy SEAL Team One, I put on the cloth of my country, shipped out with a sense of confidence, conviction, and patriotic duty to our nation, _and served with undying honor._ Fighting for this country has always been personal to me, and I will hold that honor close to my chest for as long as I live.
---

As the only veteran in this race, I feel a responsibility to step up and lead with the conviction I'll never shake from my time in the service. I believe our country deserves a Commander-in-Chief who truly understands what we're fighting for and what we're fighting against. _The gravity of the situation we're now facing is nothing short of_** _dire_** _._ Our nation's once-proud fighting force has been infected and paralyzed by a political agenda, our military recruitment levels have reached an all-time low, and yet we are expected to salute our "Commander-in-Chief," Joe Biden. Not only is this a slap in the face to the veterans across this country, but it is an insult to _every_ soldier who has come before our time:
* Those 56 men who pledged their lives in Independence Hall in 1776 so that they could create a new nation conceived in liberty.

* Our nation's first Republican President who stood at a cemetery in Gettysburg and pledged this nation to a new birth of freedom.

* That band of brothers who stormed the beaches of Normandy, defeated the Nazis, and saved this world.

As a veteran, as a former Congressman, as Governor, and as a father, I have remained steadfast in my devotion to reminding those who will listen of the words of Ronald Reagan: **_Freedom is one generation away from extinction; it's not passed along in the bloodstream, and it must be protected and cultivated._** Today, I am humbly asking you for support to help me fire Joe Biden and restore**this mission and sanity, pride, integrity, and capability** to the chief office of our military.

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Our nation's first Republican President who stood at a cemetery in Gettysburg and pledged this nation to a new birth of freedom. That band of brothers who stormed the beaches of Normandy, defeated the Nazis, and saved this world. As a veteran, as a former Congressman, as Governor, and as a father, I have remained steadfast in my devotion to reminding those who will listen of the words of Ronald Reagan: Freedom is one generation away from extinction; it's not passed along in the bloodstream, and it must be protected and cultivated. Today, I am humbly asking you for support to help me fire Joe Biden and restorethis mission and sanity, pride, integrity, and capability to the chief office of our military. | | And Fellow Conservative, I am also asking you for one more thing. Please, as our freedoms continue to come under fire every day that we allow Joe Biden to sit in our Oval Office, choose to stand on the side of freedom today, and always. I need you fighting with me. Yours in Freedom, | Ron DeSantis | | | Get to Know Ron DeSantis | | | Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children. | On Day One, Ron DeSantis has promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. name: Your America
subject: Your thoughts on American Education
body:
You are an informed citizen--I believe that wholeheartedly.

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35447%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XvGgjjkfk1HDSHfkUedhmA&sysid=1)
---
| | Good day, fellow American. You are an informed citizen--I believe that wholeheartedly. You love this country. You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren’t afraid to stand up for America’s founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. _**[Your leadership and knowledge are needed today ...](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35448%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jRjasydIj2EUmym5AlEKbg&sysid=1)**_

## Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution?
[Yes](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35449%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=goa5sv1FduRBYxJVrHVWTA&sysid=1) [No](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35440%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2b6FaxB6PHatnLQhQKOi47g&sysid=1) [Not Sure / Don't Know](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35441%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=TrR%2boC9apMRMvBkLsj%2bKcg&sysid=1)
We need more citizens like you--_informed citizens_ --because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can’t let that happen! That’s why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative--the **CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS**. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand
* WHAT the Constitution says;
* HOW it relates to current issues and events; and
* WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty.

If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that “educators” deliberately deceived or who just haven’t learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. **You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable. ** That’s because we’re seeking _1,000 people_ in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to _10,000,000 Americans_ , and this initiative starts with you--YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what’s best for the country. So please, share your opinions by completing the **National Survey on the State of American Education **today at the link below. Thank you for reading my email! [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/survey-informed-citizen/**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35442%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2bOar%2bSdNcm68rnyRGXb2hw&sysid=1) For our children, Bill Gray Class of 2001 Vice President National Donor Outreach Hillsdale College
---

name: Pro Life Update
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future.

This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zi92sd3cii7dvchocbr99cpuui9ca8fqd84lu8po_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1gm6o32c5h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zr8buej87u90jj4702p0bod4o74m8r0020fehfso_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1gm6o32c5h2bs) For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale’s American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z3hoogirhndldo7nun86ktrfa9m0aj1tefueltk8_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1gm6o32c5h2bs) And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

subject: Your thoughts on American Education
body:
You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zq5g8bmt680e8p5rka5fnv062tveoe2d0c1g8jgg_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1gm6o32c5h2bs)

| | Good day, fellow American. You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly. You love this country. You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren’t afraid to stand up for America’s founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. _**[Your leadership and knowledge are needed today...](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z4suaggf1svqssrmqs8littqcn9vj7tmhfbec188_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1gm6o32c5h2bs)_**

## Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution?
[Yes](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zpovuiho82vc2hb3or91es8is1e7a738sv3602j8_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1gm6o32c5h2bs) [No](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zhdsh6cb96t8n0ik6169kasaign1bp7tuiv58qao_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1gm6o32c5h2bs) [Not Sure / Don't Know](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zs0oo4f5h3dls7hhfna77dkqktte87kqjuolmaro_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1gm6o32c5h2bs)
We need more citizens like you— _informed citizens_ —because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can’t let that happen! That’s why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative—the **CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS**. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand
* WHAT the Constitution says;
* HOW it relates to current issues and events; and
* WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty.

If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that “educators” deliberately deceived or who just haven’t learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. **You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable.** That’s because we’re seeking _1,000 people_ in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to _10,000,000 Americans_ , and this initiative starts with you—YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what’s best for the country. So please, share your opinions by completing the **National Survey on the State of American Education** today at the link below. Thank you for reading my email! [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/survey-informed-citizen/**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zrvdup1rvrhk0j4nhvnp2pe3mgsa35soj87n66jg_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1gm6o32c5h2bs) For our children, Bill Gray Class of 2001 Vice President National Donor Outreach Hillsdale College

subject: Your thoughts on American Education
body:
You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly.

This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z1pq9lavf7hq2obpp1v6lhjrtfv2h5sr8usge918_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1gm9or1c1h2bs)

| | Good day, fellow American. You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly. You love this country. You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren’t afraid to stand up for America’s founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. _**[Your leadership and knowledge are needed today...](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z652j5ff392av8bfuaib0a7tjphfe1o3bmk5lpt8_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1gm9or1c1h2bs)_**

## Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution?
[Yes](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zcgns18gp78qm28477g9erpfq2q5ndl5s0moqa48_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1gm9or1c1h2bs) [No](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z55u4j1hgrptg6jdickgftrqmpjiot8l9m9ebs2o_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1gm9or1c1h2bs) [Not Sure / Don't Know](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zb2sj9dkaebi8ok1u191omd3tm79o8uhcqbjmb30_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1gm9or1c1h2bs)
We need more citizens like you— _informed citizens_ —because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can’t let that happen! That’s why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative—the **CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS**. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand
* WHAT the Constitution says;
* HOW it relates to current issues and events; and
* WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty.

If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that “educators” deliberately deceived or who just haven’t learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. **You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable.** That’s because we’re seeking _1,000 people_ in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to _10,000,000 Americans_ , and this initiative starts with you—YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what’s best for the country. So please, share your opinions by completing the **National Survey on the State of American Education** today at the link below. Thank you for reading my email! [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/survey-informed-citizen/**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z1paj9lvkdfbmbo395vuvim385kcmnepbb1958ho_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1gm9or1c1h2bs) For our children, Bill Gray Class of 2001 Vice President National Donor Outreach Hillsdale College

name: Ron DeSantis
subject: This is why I served
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron DeSantis for President
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWhajIripN

Years ago, I volunteered to serve in our nation's military, and
nothing could shake the indescribable sense of pride I gained
from those years...

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWhajIripN

Friend,

If
you've heard my story, you know that I went from being a
blue-collar kid in Florida, to attending Yale on a baseball
scholarship, to working my way through Harvard Law School... all
leading up to the day I saw our freedom come under fire on
September 11th, 2001, and volunteering to serve in the proudest
fighting force in the world.

When I deployed to Iraq with U.S. Navy SEAL Team One, I put on
the cloth of my country, shipped out with a sense of confidence,
conviction, and patriotic duty to our nation, and served with
undying honor. Fighting for this country has always been personal
to me, and I will hold that honor close to my chest for as long
as I live.

As
the only veteran in this race, I feel a responsibility to step up
and lead with the conviction I'll never shake from my time in the
service. I believe our country deserves a Commander-in-Chief who
truly understands what we're fighting for and what we're fighting
against.

The
gravity of the situation we're now facing is nothing short of
dire.

Our
nation's once-proud fighting force has been infected and
paralyzed by a political agenda, our military recruitment levels
have reached an all-time low, and yet we are expected to salute
our "Commander-in-Chief," Joe Biden.

Not
only is this a slap in the face to the veterans across this
country, but it is an insult to every soldier who has come before
our time:

Those 56 men who pledged their lives in Independence Hall in 1776
so that they could create a new nation conceived in liberty.

Our nation's first Republican President who stood at a cemetery
in Gettysburg and pledged this nation to a new birth of freedom.

That band of brothers who stormed the beaches of Normandy,
defeated the Nazis, and saved this world.

As
a veteran, as a former Congressman, as Governor, and as a father,
I have remained steadfast in my devotion to reminding those who
will listen of the words of Ronald Reagan:

Freedom is one generation away from extinction; it's not passed
along in the bloodstream, and it must be protected and
cultivated.

Today, I am humbly asking you for support to help me fire Joe
Biden and restore this mission and sanity, pride, integrity, and
capability to the chief office of our military.

Support my campaign for President

And
Friend, I am also asking you for one more thing. Please, as our
freedoms continue to come under fire every day that we allow Joe
Biden to sit in our Oval Office, choose to stand on the side of
freedom today, and always. I need you fighting with me.

Yours in Freedom,

Ron
DeSantis

Get to Know Ron DeSantis

Ron DeSantis comes from
blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to
him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the
Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate
degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was
so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered
to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a
life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and
now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting
to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in
this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every
turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and
consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his
life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and
3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that
this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents
face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political
agenda down the throats of children.

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has
promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected
bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to
children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by
immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our
southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the
mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring
our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on
track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record
speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment,
politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the
legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his
leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has
stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next
President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill
for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for
President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the
decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for
another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act
is now.

name: Kirk Cameron
subject: BREAKING - SkyTree Book Fairs challenges Scholastic’s monopoly
body:
Here’s what we’re up against.

[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zo5ati1t20f0iltr84o7r1tud2g6ga4r22892f7o_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1im6o74cth2bs "SkyTree Book Fairs")

Friend,

SkyTree Book Fair and I did a deep dive and discovered the cause of why sexually explicit and disgusting books get into our children's schools, classrooms, and libraries.

Here's what we're up against.

These are books Scholastic promotes at book fairs in schools. Here are pages from "Welcome to St. Hell," a 2022 Scholastic book glamorizing gender transitioning to middle schoolers. (We've censored these pages as the original content could violate social media policies against adult material):

[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2ztoq2vkia215fbo6d54gvu1cp2dqab3uv0vhqup8_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1im6o74cth2bs)[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zlumqgkgl7k0efrgojv9dsuks05n9cl57ciklt8g_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1im6o74cth2bs)

Scholastic holds a virtual monopoly on school book fairs. Like many of our cultural institutions in the last decade, Scholastic has fallen prey to the woke mob and radical LGBT political agenda.

Scholastic promotes this agenda over the well-being of our children.

**Here is the solution:**

SkyTree Book Fair offers schools a different option for book fairs. SkyTree Book Fairs is providing schools, parents, and children with an empowering alternative with literature rooted in truth and family values that matches the quality and ease of Scholastic while countering their harmful agenda.

Here's how you can help.

[I am asking for your urgent support to help SkyTree replace Scholastic in schools. Can you donate $35, $50, or even $100 today toward Sky Tree? We are kicking off with a goal to raise $100,000 this month.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zg0fu521vi6riodknra9a759g6bl80ch3ttnlji0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1im6o74cth2bs)

[Donate](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zmghvfa2jih0a4scj4rp9c7v7lt4f9b3vmk1l0jo_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1im6o74cth2bs)

SkyTree was inspired by my first children's book, As You Grow. Now, I am helping them spread to schools across the country as an alternative to Scholastic. And here's the thing: SkyTree will not only promote age-appropriate books, but they will do so more efficiently to make it easier for schools to choose SkyTree over Scholastic.

And it's working!

SkyTree has already secured its first public school book fair in Spotsylvania, VA!

No more race-infused storylines. No more confusing gender content. Only age-appropriate content that will nurture childhood innocence and character.

SkyTree needs your support today. American children need your support today!!

We are quickly lining up hundreds of new book fairs in the Spring semester. It costs roughly $7,500 to host a book fair. Please help sponsor SkyTree book fairs in schools across the country.

[Donate $1,000 >>](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zkqei87q5f01hibkr4v8f8o9endbpmgk2pcfsujo_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1im6o74cth2bs)

Let's bring back wholesome content to kids, like what we had growing up. Kids should remain innocent and have content to encourage their moral character while fostering their imagination.

It's not complicated! It's what you and I grew up with.

Thank you for helping us offer schools an alternative to Scholastic!

God bless,

Kirk Cameron

| Announcement:
---
| I'm a Father, a Navy SEAL, a Day One Trump Supporter, a Christian Conservative, and a Pro-Life, Pro-Gun Business Owner running to SAVE AMERICA and HELP THE PEOPLE.
---
|
---
| McGuire and Trump all the way!
---
| Friends,
I wanted you to be the first to know that I'm running for Congress.
Together, we can save this great country.
Here's how we do it:

* Get President Donald J. Trump back in the White House
* Unify the Republican Party behind Trump and focus on beating the Democrats and their Marxist, freedom-crushing policies
* Deliver results for the American people

I'm working hard every day on accomplishing those three goals. However, Bob Good has betrayed these goals by betraying Trump.
On the day our president was wrongly indicted, Bob abandoned Trump by endorsing another candidate. Story: [Good back stabs Trump Click here.](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nJUFeDBjwEgWdfzy77Sg145J1ZTC99P3bu5SkK0PF9TQyuz_sm7F0M2Q5HmDro_QI7OCqZ57B60toRLkSC9EpV0DUThOjhAef-wEVRWaU1jLAWLgPkpPE5QerRb6P4iBfKo_zSfD5IAE5GqwjUlxqpzbzeC1GIUHZLOw_uf8WIIWBxZvTK9mgwrqrFnomXbi3GYVHlhaIkiZaEfR288eNNyTGYweJ-HFVBnjoK4vf-8=&c=nTWYaj_9QkAQ4H2KWTu_sWDI8EPWbweIms6U6zdfXQMIVKHvfgBQVg==&ch=z8idGQzpG3SxBcjKfyE0LDuBdITEoGrz_jXZd_aDubFR-9KZ5wtXIQ==)
We need a new direction in the 5th Congressional District.
Here's how I see it:
Our great country is under assault and is teetering on the brink. We don't have time for politicians who are more focused on personal vanity than on We the People, we don't have time for toxic infighting that cripples our party and country, and we don't have time for do-nothing politicians.
I appreciate anyone who wants to serve in office, but our current Congressman has failed us time and time again. He's more focused on getting on the news and serving himself than on serving the people.
Our current Congressman voted for Kevin McCarthy to be Speaker, then threw a temper tantrum, reversed himself, and allowed the party to fall into chaos, costing us the 2023 elections.
Republicans came together around Mike Johnson, who is now working to clean up the mess our Congressman created by his chaos-causing temper tantrum, costing us the majority here in Virginia.
As you know, Marxist Democrats now control the Virginia General Assembly, which is going to hurt the people of Virginia badly. Instead of our current Congressman helping the GOP team and the people of Virginia, he helped himself -- and the Democrats.
Ever since I won the convention to be your nominee for state senate, people from across the district have been urging me to run against the entrenched, establishment Congressman who has only served himself. I'm answering the call.
There are other consequences of our current Congressman's failed approach. When our strongest ally, Israel, was attacked by terrorists who burned babies, killed 32 American citizens and took at least 10 American citizens hostage, our Congressman didn't help.
In addition, one of the primary concerns I hear from people in the 5th Congressional District is how our current Congressman treats them personally. We The People are not interested in having someone represent us who yells at grandmothers to try and intimidate them. There is no honor in that behavior and those who keep giving him a pass are complicit. How can Republicans build a majority and win when you treat fellow Republicans or anyone that way? I will do what I must.
I have a Biblical worldview and will always stand up for righteousness. That's why I'm answering the call from folks all over the 5th district to run for this seat.
I look forward to continuing my service in the General Assembly during this campaign. In contrast to our current Congressman, I've passed many bills that improve the lives of Virginians. My team and I will keep working hard on constituent services, so if you need anything, contact us. There's nothing more satisfying than helping Virginians navigate the bureaucracy and win.
In this battle for America's future, as a Navy SEAL, I cannot not sit by and watch our country fall apart. We can do better than Good.
I deeply appreciate the support so many have shown for me in the past and I'd be deeply appreciative if I can count on your support in the future.
---

[](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=96a84c613fcd4052a9c96bd446325155&_e=s41Atr4WJ2wLtxKEF3PAvk_J3gkTebpTJruQWnZufODKw3eMOJDTvpTYk4ARN7pO2u4Z9DAgWYRpMuNPiSZ_OFwEvE6BL9kumLZmuLZFJVxaxwgvfj6bwFn9hpc0trQiPY3ppf7MlWwzo6MHRGeaGLBZH96FqlG80JSGzMnB27ZFElOfDtPQMG4bhmDGI-qxfORzDgcZqpwfCbGnvPBIhEQ-k6ExdxT4trtlAwzQMh3eSyclwiqWdIr7a9KIBOce "SkyTree Book Fairs")

Friend,

SkyTree Book Fair and I did a deep dive and discovered the cause of why sexually explicit and disgusting books get into our children's schools, classrooms, and libraries.

Here's what we're up against.

Scholastic holds a virtual monopoly on school book fairs. Like many of our cultural institutions in the last decade, Scholastic has fallen prey to the woke mob and radical LGBT political agenda.

Scholastic promotes this agenda over the well-being of our children.

**Here is the solution:**

SkyTree Book Fair offers schools a different option for book fairs. SkyTree Book Fairs is providing schools, parents, and children with an empowering alternative with literature rooted in truth and family values that matches the quality and ease of Scholastic while countering their harmful agenda.

You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren't afraid to stand up for America's founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. _**[Your leadership and knowledge are needed today ...](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fa5c12d3a36542d1b0b6fef2714cd028&_e=B3-oGHxW0t5rebyEniqmETpPG_zTGgVMmOwsBCMechnIAGEM299czw_9Vmkn-OKIVEVqSq6yYPeM-HSWX4iDjBMt6bnyQ60vft_vxPP_tPqaFyqLJ8tvuY_41guyGlGDJ9n8tpuCFHL2i24qknUIt2tNiegicBbMNKwsOyRNtLnUAm4xFazTwItIwRyzULJIxgczkpuzA1uXzT0UdGnk87s1TaEWyUv4RkBgjC05P_EP1nt2LhTjN4T3DZU0O3RLrY8HjyvBVWf4YtvYc51ILwcrx_2NuKhATuzotqPfIbdegwB4MnN5nqRZ12cnBp9rzzfpCXSQc-F5k0yAv0xq97YH2pktbJaGpu4bxSYCnBqviRawPj2S-xoG4JxPRktJ7PPSavkRwiFNw7vEJG9lKQ%3D%3D)**_

## Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution?
[Yes](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fa5c12d3a36542d1b0b6fef2714cd028&_e=B3-oGHxW0t5rebyEniqmETpPG_zTGgVMmOwsBCMechnIAGEM299czw_9Vmkn-OKIVEVqSq6yYPeM-HSWX4iDjBMt6bnyQ60vft_vxPP_tPqaFyqLJ8tvuY_41guyGlGDJ9n8tpuCFHL2i24qknUIt2tNiegicBbMNKwsOyRNtLnUAm4xFazTwItIwRyzULJIxgczkpuzA1uXzT0UdGnk87s1TaEWyUv4RkBgjC05P_EP1nt2LhTjN4T3DZU0O3RLabbX4n-l9NQSELj9jsFKChCRfbGln0RFjyc7WoTSaXyThXKbxT3WJDxkRQ0yD53vQKrsHZbuewyvXGsS5MzMuHu_L0zh0M1yj7elbu6gRUlP0UZvX5vovmDDt3bf0QaHZ_CLNpbWra1A98TfkV7IAA%3D%3D) [No](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fa5c12d3a36542d1b0b6fef2714cd028&_e=B3-oGHxW0t5rebyEniqmETpPG_zTGgVMmOwsBCMechnIAGEM299czw_9Vmkn-OKIVEVqSq6yYPeM-HSWX4iDjBMt6bnyQ60vft_vxPP_tPqaFyqLJ8tvuY_41guyGlGDJ9n8tpuCFHL2i24qknUIt2tNiegicBbMNKwsOyRNtLnUAm4xFazTwItIwRyzULJIxgczkpuzA1uXzT0UdGnk87s1TaEWyUv4RkBgjC05P_EP1nt2LhTjN4T3DZU0O3RLf-k_i5Gr5DXXQmXG2z8qPkePc1wUjNdsbi6lQoQKUU1WQ1ibbkohKfLJ-1096AfnDgDh9Bm9xEwgqu5wMDAmOBzR1LtV_BhyYgqMeiODrqLcJyoiySCqBpCTLTiKSxIE9sFjR8Al6pG4IRp4Ek1-vw%3D%3D) [Not Sure / Don't Know](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fa5c12d3a36542d1b0b6fef2714cd028&_e=B3-oGHxW0t5rebyEniqmETpPG_zTGgVMmOwsBCMechnIAGEM299czw_9Vmkn-OKIVEVqSq6yYPeM-HSWX4iDjBMt6bnyQ60vft_vxPP_tPqaFyqLJ8tvuY_41guyGlGDJ9n8tpuCFHL2i24qknUIt2tNiegicBbMNKwsOyRNtLnUAm4xFazTwItIwRyzULJIxgczkpuzA1uXzT0UdGnk87s1TaEWyUv4RkBgjC05P_EP1nt2LhTjN4T3DZU0O3RLVTLQUhjTfS9wVa26mwV0eLJQ2ajph3y2vrnNaAWtyLfUB4skpm1ABW8CbiNj_7zmKaDHoWsEJSkWQ439qmiwnqnlTecD5ad4mJDBsigJjAAcE6X6l1wylMAsbbdl6Lp_DQlcMwmFTpMuc-MO8Ndemg%3D%3D) We need more citizens like you--_informed citizens_ --because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can't let that happen! That's why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative--the **CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS**. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand
* WHAT the Constitution says;
* HOW it relates to current issues and events; and
* WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty.

If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that "educators" deliberately deceived or who just haven't learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. **You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable. ** That's because we're seeking _1,000 people_ in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to _10,000,000 Americans_ , and this initiative starts with you--YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what's best for the country. So please, share your opinions by completing the **National Survey on the State of American Education **today at the link below. Thank you for reading my email! clean_body: You are an informed citizen--I believe that wholeheartedly. This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | | | Good day, fellow American. You are an informed citizen--I believe that wholeheartedly. You love this country. You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren't afraid to stand up for America's founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution? We need more citizens like you--informed citizens --because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can't let that happen! That's why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative--the CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand WHAT the Constitution says; HOW it relates to current issues and events; and WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty. If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that "educators" deliberately deceived or who just haven't learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable. That's because we're seeking 1,000 people in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to 10,000,000 Americans , and this initiative starts with you--YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what's best for the country. So please, share your opinions by completing the National Survey on the State of American Education **today at the link below. Thank you for reading my email! For our children, Bill Gray Class of 2001 Vice President National Donor Outreach Hillsdale College Defend the Constitution 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314 | _

We’re heartbroken, friend. **Three young gray wolves were brutally MURDERED near the Colorado-Wyoming border. These were some of Colorado’s first wild-born pups in more than 80 years – and they were SHOT TO DEATH without consequence. Now, the last surviving members of this vital wolf pack are in a dire situation and – unless we act now – decades of wolf conservation could be violently undone. **
**Trophy hunters and their Big Polluter allies are to blame for this tragedy. Here’s why: When federal protections for gray wolves were reversed, trophy hunters slaughtered hundreds of wolves in a matter of days! **Colorado conservationists have been working tirelessly to protect these majestic creatures and the forest territory they need to thrive. **But****Colorado’s wolves can be LEGALLY shot and killed as soon as they step over state lines**!
This is life and death, friend. **The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service could step in to protect our wolves, but it isn’t doing enough. Instead, the agency has ABANDONED vulnerable wolf packs in pro-hunting states like Wyoming, Montana and Idaho.** **That means young wolf pups are being tortured to death with choking snares, violent shootings and ATV chases! **
**We MUST put a stop to these merciless acts and protect our vital wildlife and the lands they need to thrive. But we urgently need to know where supporters like you stand, and we’re missing 9 responses from your area – including yours! Please, tell us before our response deadline at 11:59 p.m. tonight: **

| Friend,

Last week, the 7th Circuit Court of Appeals issued a MAJOR anti-gun ruling.

Peter,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate this past June.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=d99089996e184ab1948e6ff22e588958&_e=tB5gtb41a1vrF_clmX0x7Yj42UtOYFE-7IEnmwhafcGRPXWsntWlOPQgPQtLEqD6ZTDumrS-p2eqH_ZFZV8avv9o4x8OMTK6U3XWXHvwDHGseyp_T-t2hMy6r9QNoEOVoGAk1YaQuE1MgJPbBREV36ean7u46M9MooS3Upobh20piA5RRySp8f6s2cysegoLGOUbaxOd_dbVkfIQXm_HNFlrqiCsJKZdF2XiJ7XQ9N_A38LK-2xkdsqZvMpLXtmhYiACmv2XxWDk9DC3cKSN7Q6SX2-3dzDSufWEkgjpp0uRpQGn23QcOobIznji7n0p3PDwZl35Pa_w7nQbnyABw7EREoKO7qtm7AipZTlH6Eu8RIo3WmXaen5LDlAXM6xxS1sinXpjLqN5VIQwT2plTn2YMXABy1QgZdfnxFJBc7Vr3OLFrzYszL-_AUeqornL)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=d99089996e184ab1948e6ff22e588958&_e=tB5gtb41a1vrF_clmX0x7Yj42UtOYFE-7IEnmwhafcGRPXWsntWlOPQgPQtLEqD6ZTDumrS-p2eqH_ZFZV8avv9o4x8OMTK6U3XWXHvwDHGseyp_T-t2hMy6r9QNoEOVoGAk1YaQuE1MgJPbBREV36ean7u46M9MooS3Upobh20piA5RRySp8f6s2cysegoLGOUbaxOd_dbVkfIQXm_HNFlrqiCsJKZdF2XiJ7XQ9N_A38LK-2xkdsqZvMpLXtmhYiACmv2XxWDk9DC3cKSN7Q6SX2-3dzDSufWEkgjpp0sd3H_rQFmx3fV2-u4Dg4uUgKjPUi1YE8-gf3WaOn8NDvjmE93Q6oeoFRSTB08fOOkoWaLzMcHqSRW2boWOELg9WDYT1AV1AwZgGOvWiEHOFYZcN1fV6hM1JZfjsJT966snUnS46AwSonLchJLL8smw)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=d99089996e184ab1948e6ff22e588958&_e=tB5gtb41a1vrF_clmX0x7Yj42UtOYFE-7IEnmwhafcGRPXWsntWlOPQgPQtLEqD6nbn-EsnZPYvottGpMxJDV5b3iI9V-UedYm4U1cLvls2X-9Cb4N6jd28EH7uTvIyZmtfAk3SynYNXGPtaqBXJGIG6_y-jObKHEqXozB0oy1AhbF3Sy8EMusqBG0fpYh4Sr7oO-lvUoVRMj0T2udCiDn-U9OImVtFiU1zpR1_3NWF262grk18KUOzX7fZ7VQGCq3W4zCN_zbpxSz3VBNCzN6YC-62_RWQHXRglGdRwiW9kkZGsj5knNacgyGn4qkkzmC4xGrnxJ_WA46-XEQ-KRGuuR_qMYH5GFiUZ1jeaMdmZEILTyZWnc-Tl7ma9rrsaEjMpci63V0kRRlUPIdCnYslmjiJLMXUfqiF7pG0-qgo%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, **[I’m going to need the help of every conservative donor who reads this letter.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=d99089996e184ab1948e6ff22e588958&_e=tB5gtb41a1vrF_clmX0x7Yj42UtOYFE-7IEnmwhafcGRPXWsntWlOPQgPQtLEqD6ZTDumrS-p2eqH_ZFZV8avv9o4x8OMTK6U3XWXHvwDHGseyp_T-t2hMy6r9QNoEOVoGAk1YaQuE1MgJPbBREV36ean7u46M9MooS3Upobh20piA5RRySp8f6s2cysegoLGOUbaxOd_dbVkfIQXm_HNFlrqiCsJKZdF2XiJ7XQ9N_A38LK-2xkdsqZvMpLXtmhYiACmv2XxWDk9DC3cKSN7Q6SX2-3dzDSufWEkgjpp0sOzPyDtG5XJmH6Fe69oK9MmTdXwJ3pDJE8bMS0oUFj-LSTkTOqZiug8ow5vpB7bqEBxw3-jEVgrnswCh5SxZQmhorpmDjdcoIpBT1Z74RDz0z8YRt285_eqO9gtAOQvkRKREnSZFHUPyzs938p0Ga-) **

Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes.

And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times.

I want to look at my children and tell them, _**“Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.”**_

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=d99089996e184ab1948e6ff22e588958&_e=tB5gtb41a1vrF_clmX0x7Yj42UtOYFE-7IEnmwhafcGRPXWsntWlOPQgPQtLEqD6ZTDumrS-p2eqH_ZFZV8avv9o4x8OMTK6U3XWXHvwDHGseyp_T-t2hMy6r9QNoEOVoGAk1YaQuE1MgJPbBREV36ean7u46M9MooS3Upobh20piA5RRySp8f6s2cysegoLGOUbaxOd_dbVkfIQXm_HNFlrqiCsJKZdF2XiJ7XQ9N_A38LK-2xkdsqZvMpLXtmhYiACmv2XxWDk9DC3cKSN7Q6SX2-3dzDSufWEkgjpp0t8nOZS6v6PBwT_EiekoH-wa00a62TBqTUeQgi9dPZEDXAjYtHSyn4Cz6Wo1Te0eRT2rmY1EBnsZJE7YxNQxN0O9Izq9Sc4PXE7gbzMapHxGZE2eGnBw8ql0dvYhqBAP5lpJyC0QG3BNkjZEk0F_oxQ)

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: last chance, Pro-Life Friend!
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I’m worried.

I know I’ve emailed you a lot over the last several days.

But I’m reaching out one more time – because nothing would make the Abortion Lobby happier than if we fail to meet our monthly donor recruitment goal before tonight’s 11:59 PM deadline.

Pro-Life Friend, we are **ONE YEAR AWAY** from Election Day 2024.

With the stakes higher than ever for our country and the pro-life movement, **[can I count on you to please sign up as a _Students for Life Action_ monthly contributor – at least through November 2024](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjhjkty-duchtdja-y/)?**

[ |
--- ](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjhjkty-duchtdja-j/)
Monthly contributors are so critical to all we do because they:

**1)_Allow us to fight Planned Parenthood’s millions during critical election years_.**

With the media, politicians in BOTH parties, Hollywood fat-cats, and Planned Parenthood’s millions all on their side, the Abortion Lobby starts off with some huge advantages.

But thousands of monthly contributors – giving $10 or $25 a month – helps create a snowball effect enabling you and me to make a “Big Money” impact, which can be absolutely critical during election years;

**2)_Guarantee a steady flow of resources I know I can count on every month_.**

This can be critical to my ability to fight bad legislation and work to pass new life-saving laws; and

**3)_Identify and train the next generation of pro-life leaders_.**

You can’t manage a big army without competent leaders. The national grassroots army that _Students for Life Action_ is building requires constant training for young people who are willing to dedicate their lives to abolishing abortion. Monthly contributors play a major role in funding our trainings.

Pro-Life Friend, as you know, we have a lot on our plates.

And with pro-abortion radicals prepared to pull every trick in the book to expand abortion nationwide, we have to fight back harder than ever.

The good news is, we don’t have to match the Abortion Lobby’s millions.

Our pro-life student leaders are gritty, courageous, and dedicated to the cause. They’re willing to sleep on couches, work early mornings, late nights, and weekends.

But it still takes precious resources to organize and mobilize.

**[That’s why I hope you’ll consider signing up as a _Students for Life Action_ monthly contributor right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjhjkty-duchtdja-i/)!**

You can sign up for as little as $10.00 per month – just $0.33 a day – at least for the next 12 months.

Pro-Life Friend, you know the stakes in 2024.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

**[>>> SIGN UP TO GIVE MONTHLY<<< ](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjhjkty-duchtdja-d/)**
