subject: Your thoughts on American Education
body:
You are an informed citizen--I believe that wholeheartedly.

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fcf29466ff8f485b847121139d39a946&_e=YyYun9JfkeaSUoXC5xc-7eDeEXRJJLBR2msuPhfmmpVHWk4T1O44HRkP0FORIri4OJl0FqUGO7Oz9FqiTyjHjB7QSORxdKF_9_54r-CZuLE4r4FEFApB55sUbypg38LymDIpKdObo4uISNuRdQQayUCv_Z0hGvs7m1v40aeA87sJqmgfjYysI7PsnyAXf-q-tc4Oslzy2Kua5g_O_Y4rmSY4XdGbojAi2v-apOAXjcEajsRxzaJrnib8nsJVvbrKKQC1u9hReeOdVA9dZTxTGLvmiuveKULVAilx7FCJoIfi4rkWH6wR9ZybQrhYfV7tNDamEowOgVTGGxEKt31ZIn7FZlneLb27tqQ1r1Cn1eE9prw8LMfWaEJE_XyExQd9Oom9LuU5fdMRRuhnGDnUlw%3D%3D)
---
| | Good day, fellow American. You are an informed citizen--I believe that wholeheartedly. You love this country. You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren't afraid to stand up for America's founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. _**[Your leadership and knowledge are needed today ...](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fcf29466ff8f485b847121139d39a946&_e=YyYun9JfkeaSUoXC5xc-7eDeEXRJJLBR2msuPhfmmpVHWk4T1O44HRkP0FORIri4OJl0FqUGO7Oz9FqiTyjHjB7QSORxdKF_9_54r-CZuLE4r4FEFApB55sUbypg38LymDIpKdObo4uISNuRdQQayUCv_Z0hGvs7m1v40aeA87sJqmgfjYysI7PsnyAXf-q-tc4Oslzy2Kua5g_O_Y4rmSY4XdGbojAi2v-apOAXjcEajsRxzaJrnib8nsJVvbrKHt3Dt7Zgksa-bpcg5fHnvFjR01qIEKtlAvsQiKCr8kCCE8nGlD11M96y1TBNH_dmoDWGxUAzuRYF0kq2wdX3fmxHYf2juw3jn_bByiW1sAqwmEx_9vX5FO2P8dGohFf9kU3yx2ctHYXIAtXwuYytXA%3D%3D)**_

## Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution?
[Yes](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fcf29466ff8f485b847121139d39a946&_e=YyYun9JfkeaSUoXC5xc-7eDeEXRJJLBR2msuPhfmmpVHWk4T1O44HRkP0FORIri4OJl0FqUGO7Oz9FqiTyjHjB7QSORxdKF_9_54r-CZuLE4r4FEFApB55sUbypg38LymDIpKdObo4uISNuRdQQayUCv_Z0hGvs7m1v40aeA87sJqmgfjYysI7PsnyAXf-q-tc4Oslzy2Kua5g_O_Y4rmSY4XdGbojAi2v-apOAXjcEajsRxzaJrnib8nsJVvbrKu2qo8i_mFdznbhsvJvAWCQWsajdYqBjJ-JYrO5QQQvU1CrS2dJphGRpZSlWgtCEJBCdP1vU5oTEAcwahTCVLKtLD4dVIu_OPcxxOXhwPiF8fyOfTowvC4ecTAw257_zKhRKJdcwUu6vSidTjmEu75A%3D%3D) [No](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fcf29466ff8f485b847121139d39a946&_e=YyYun9JfkeaSUoXC5xc-7eDeEXRJJLBR2msuPhfmmpVHWk4T1O44HRkP0FORIri4OJl0FqUGO7Oz9FqiTyjHjB7QSORxdKF_9_54r-CZuLE4r4FEFApB55sUbypg38LymDIpKdObo4uISNuRdQQayUCv_Z0hGvs7m1v40aeA87sJqmgfjYysI7PsnyAXf-q-tc4Oslzy2Kua5g_O_Y4rmSY4XdGbojAi2v-apOAXjcEajsRxzaJrnib8nsJVvbrK3ZzJvHxrJQ0taunAKmg3hhvi0o4Va3RkSnoCCYUEzhHVsjQ_5b6rliIdfdNC4Y7adLC6evtSO1do79xtk8ke6uhRXuj7Cn9bUv6hhJnzgb2zcYVifhg7-BO0CsaqBrbaNlt4Xqz5yEyjX3-lk6r5iA%3D%3D) [Not Sure / Don't Know](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fcf29466ff8f485b847121139d39a946&_e=YyYun9JfkeaSUoXC5xc-7eDeEXRJJLBR2msuPhfmmpVHWk4T1O44HRkP0FORIri4OJl0FqUGO7Oz9FqiTyjHjB7QSORxdKF_9_54r-CZuLE4r4FEFApB55sUbypg38LymDIpKdObo4uISNuRdQQayUCv_Z0hGvs7m1v40aeA87sJqmgfjYysI7PsnyAXf-q-tc4Oslzy2Kua5g_O_Y4rmSY4XdGbojAi2v-apOAXjcEajsRxzaJrnib8nsJVvbrKds98PqC2MO7jgcK9_wRVv97y-QydOk1I8uha54YaIMfBkaK3Zv6o5Fb_8b6rJgvSGeqqz5yhlznjC0O5gumpIKI-5ajB_NlJhn_CESFJD_MprYt4atO4rFX5hpKkaaj_e9ivXv5Xo-Fx5IDT_lQSuw%3D%3D) We need more citizens like you--_informed citizens_ --because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can't let that happen! That's why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative--the **CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS**. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand
* WHAT the Constitution says;
* HOW it relates to current issues and events; and
* WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty.

If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. name: Mario for Congress
subject: Mario Fratto for Congress 2024
body:
Dear Friends and Supporters,

I am excited to announce that I have launched my 2024 bid for U.S. Congress. As someone who supported my previous campaign, I wanted to reach out to you directly to tell you this news. In 2022, we were able to achieve what many thought was impossible and ran an energized campaign winning over 40% of the vote despite the obstacles of redistricting, limited time, and a fraction of the money of my opponent, Claudia Tenney.

As we approach the new election cycle, Claudia Tenney's dedication to the Uniparty and Establishment interests have taken priority over representing the traditional values of her constituents. New York District 24 has now seen this up close and personal, and the voters are ready for real change. We are ready for a candidate who will not only stand up against woke ideology and special interests but unapologetically advocate for the values and concerns of those in our district.

The 2024 Republican Primary will be held on June 25th, and I am confident we will win. Your continued help is needed to ensure this victory. We will build on our fantastic grassroots network of supporters across the twelve counties of District 24.

We are looking for volunteers to make phone calls, walk door-to-door, set up a meet and greet in their town, or simply hand out cards to friends about the campaign. Please use the link below to give feedback on ways to volunteer.

We won’t be receiving corporate PAC money so every dollar counts. Please consider if a donation is possible for this campaign.

As we start this effort to send better representation to Washington, DC, I look forward to seeing you around the district as we hit the campaign trail! Stay tuned to my website for upcoming events near you.

Thank you again for your steadfast support.

Sincerely,

Mario

MarioForCongress.com<http://www.MarioForCongress.com>

Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.

name: Blake Dellinger
subject: It's That Time - Let's Volunteer for Laura Friedman for Congress
body:
Friends,

It's that time! We're fired up and ready to reach out to voters for Laura. Will you join us?

We appreciate that you took the time to sign up to volunteer, now is the time where we can use your help to ensure voters know about Laura and why we need her to represent CA-30 in Congress.

We have plenty of scheduled canvassing and phone banking opportunities between now and the holidays, so please consider signing up for any of the events on the link below.

[**Use this form to****sign up**](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScbj5Ky3M-QbSqh9W1Z-C_F0-PGp7AGdKKkU4KlMmfMXi5vow/viewform) for ongoing volunteer opportunities to reach out to voters and elect Laura Friedman to Congress!

If you want to share with your friends, you can have them sign up anytime at **[www.LauraForCongress.org/Volunteer](http://www.LauraForCongress.org/Volunteer)**.

Here is a description of our current volunteer opportunities.

**Phone Banking**

We will be holding scheduled virtual phone banks over zoom, where you can call CA-30 voters from the comfort of your home.

**Canvassing**

Join Laura in person to knock on doors, meet voters, and hand out campaign material.

If you have any questions, please feel free to email us anytime. We look forward to seeing you on the phones and in the field!

Thank you,
Blake Dellinger
Laura Friedman for Congress

| | | My fellow Americans – this is Mike Johnson.

_**[This is a longer email but I’m humbly asking you to read it start to finish.](http://trk.faithandlibertymail. "This is a longer email but I’m humbly asking you to read it start to finish.")**_

Why? Because the moment I was elected Speaker by my Republican colleagues, the Radical Left IMMEDIATELY unleashed a coordinated, preplanned political hit job against me.
* The Liberal Media spun up hit piece after hit piece to smear me in the press – Biden’s former Press Secretary even attacked me for being a Christian on MSNBC.
* Politico fired off this headline: _“Democrats rev up the opposition machine against Mike Johnson.”_
* And I can’t even begin to tell you how many Democrat fundraising emails and texts I saw in the minutes following the final vote – I’m bracing myself for the next FEC reports.

Look:

These vicious attacks are a dime a dozen in Washington. They don’t intimidate me. _But I’ll let you in on a little secret: that’s not _really_ the goal..._

The _real_ goal of this political ambush is two-fold: **1)** smear the good names of every House Republican to hurt them electorally, and **2)** scare Liberals enough to whip out their credit cards, fill in their info, and donate to Democrats.

**It’s about power and money. Nothing else.**

That’s why it’s mission-critical that we stand up for ourselves in critical moments like this. _**[So as one of my first moves as Speaker, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian – Majority Leader Steve Scalise – to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.](http://trk.faithandlibertymail. "So as one of my first moves as Speaker, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian – Majority Leader Steve Scalise – to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.")**_

It’s ambitious. I get it. But that’s the bare minimum we need to fully fund our campaign operations in battleground races across the country.

**If we fall short of that, we’ll be forced to SLASH our voter contact budgets, GUT our digital outreach efforts, and pull our ads OFF THE AIRWAVES. Nothing could be worse for our plans to defend and expand our slim House Majority.**

So here’s my final pitch to you:

We urgently need your help. Not next week, not in the new year – right here and right now.

The difference between a strong Conservative Majority and one controlled by the Liberal Machine will come down to can’t-miss fundraising goals just like this.

Let me make myself perfectly clear:

_I’m not asking you to pitch in more than you can afford. If you can spare $50 or $100, I would be tremendously grateful. But if you can only spare $5 or $10, I would be equally appreciative._

_**[The ONLY thing I ask is for every Conservative in the country to chip in SOMETHING.](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._LM3rvUY9kYi2aW7zQ "The ONLY thing I ask is for every Conservative in the country to chip in SOMETHING.")**_

That will be the difference between victory and defeat. So what do you say? Can I count you in?

This is all thanks to people like you. The people who dare to hope for a better future in our nation—a future where our communities are safe from the threat of gun violence.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

subject: MIGOP Aids in Court Win
body:
Thanks to the leadership of Chairwoman Karamo, we saw a big win. | | | |
---
| | |
# MIGOP Amicus Brief Aids in Court Ruling
---
|
---
| Lansing, MI - November 15, 2023

In a significant ruling this week, the Michigan Court of Claims, presided over by Hon. James Robert Redford, denied a request for declaratory and injunctive relief sought by the former chair of the Michigan Democrat Party and others against Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson.

The plaintiffs sought to disqualify Donald J. Trump from the Michigan presidential primary ballot for 2024 and the general election, invoking Section 3 of the Fourteenth Amendment. However, the Court determined that this matter presents a “nonjusticiable political question” and does not meet the criteria for declaratory relief due to the “ripeness” of the claims.

The Court’s detailed analysis acknowledged the complexity and politically sensitive nature of the plaintiffs’ claims. It emphasized the role of Congress and the electoral process in determining the qualifications of presidential candidates, citing the Constitution’s provisions and past precedents as well as the rights of each state party’s role in determining presidential candidates.

Hon. Redford, in his comments, highlighted the comprehensive statutory scheme guiding the Secretary of State’s actions: “Under those requirements, while the Secretary is mandated to act, she retains discretion as to what media sources to consider when choosing which candidates to list on the notices she provides to the respective political parties under MCL 168.614a. However, the ultimate decision is made by the respective political party, with the consent of the listed candidates.”

This ruling highlights the Michigan Legislature’s established process for placing candidates on the presidential primary ballot, which seems to be evermore attacked by the day. This process, as the Court noted, is designed to assist political parties in selecting their presidential candidates.

The Court found that the plaintiffs’ request for relief concerning President Trump’s inclusion on Michigan’s primary election ballot is not ripe for judicial review, falling under the purview of political questions not justiciable by the court.

As alluded to in the Court document, the amicus brief filed by MIGOP, through the leadership of Chairwoman Karamo and thanks to the excellent representation of the ACLJ, played a significant role in this victory.

The Michigan Republican Party promises to continue battling on the front lines for the freedom of every American and every Michigander.

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=818%2E135344%2ErsE3T1)

Friend --
The Republican Senate primary in Michigan just got a whole lot messier with the entrance of Peter Meijer into the race. His entry, and the sequence of events that followed pretty much tell you the state of the Michigan Republican Party:
About four hours after Meijer launched the Michigan GOP tweeted out a reminder that Meijer voted to impeach Donald Trump (just in case anyone forgot!) About 30 minutes later they retracted the tweet and blamed it on an “overzealous intern” and claimed that the official Michigan Republican Party would remain neutral.
Then, not one hour later, the National Republican Senatorial Committee -- the *official* national organization that works to elect Republicans to the Senate – put out their own statement slamming Peter Meijer for getting into the race and saying he "isn't viable" in the GOP primary.
Peter hit back, saying that the NRSC is “not aligned” with Michigan Republicans. It’s almost hard to keep track of the jabs between all of the invested parties. James Craig (another primary contender) hit back at Meijer’s announcement, stating that Michiganders “are sick and tired of sending the same people back to Washington time and time again.”
Unfortunately, all that infighting comes with opportunity costs: if everyone is too busy fighting each other, they are certainly not focused on fighting for Michiganders. This is because, ultimately, the Michigan Republican primary is made up of (now 10 total) candidates tripping over each other to prove who is more in line with the most extreme elements of the base, not trying to connect with voters and work on their behalf.
So what can we do about it? **While Republicans are clashing over their primary candidates, we must stay focused on making our case directly with voters and getting our message out across the state.** Because the more people hear about the affirmative things our campaign stands for, the better off we'll be when it's time for the general election.
That’s why we’re asking: [**Can you make a contribution to Elissa’s campaign for Senate today?Michigan’s Republican primary might be a mess, but we are focused on building a strong foundation for success to keep Michigan blue, and your support is essential to that effort.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-nov23.RK33_Y&refcode=em231115-1-15&t=2&akid=818%2E135344%2ErsE3T1)**

| | Organized local Ds stop MAGA cold
---
| | For Democrats across America, there was a lot to cheer about in this Tuesday’s elections. Democratic Party candidates won big in a number of competitive races—including deep-red Kentucky, where Gov. Andy Beshear clobbered his Trump-backed opponent and in Virginia, where Democrats won control of the House of Delegates while maintaining their majority in the state Senate.
And, almost 17 months after the conservative-dominated U.S. Supreme Court struck down Roe v. Wade, candidates and ballot measures backing reproductive rights scored victories in a number of states with constituencies spanning the political spectrum. For example, by a strong majority voters in MAGA-controlled Ohio enshrined the right to abortion in their state constitution—a harbinger of things likely to come in other states, regardless of their political makeup. Americans, it is clear, still believe in individual freedom and personal choice.
But in Washington state’s 4th Congressional District—where MAGA has run rampant and controls most city councils, school boards, county commissions, police and sheriff departments, community organizations, housing boards and more—Tuesday’s election was devastating.
This election MAGA seized even more seats on our local school boards. This partisan takeover is causing long-term and possibly irreparable damage to our children due to MAGA policies of book banning, curriculum based on “God’s law,” erasing and shaming of LGBT+ people, defunding of school systems in favor of charter schools, animosity and suspicion towards teachers and a push to dismantle the U.S. Department of Education.

| | Despite this we see an opportunity. There has always been a chink in MAGA’s armor: truth. For too long Democrats in Central Washington have operated in the background for fear of retribution from MAGA zealots. Attacks by MAGA are well known, horrific and terrifying. As a result, Democrats here have restricted political campaigning—canvassing, text messaging, phone banking, post card mailings and conversations—to known Democrats. That represents under 30 percent of registered voters. The remaining 70 percent of voters hear only the bellowing and unending repetition of MAGA lies.
But in two places in Central Washington the Democrats were not silent. They were loud, demanding and shouting the truth. And in these two places Democrats excelled!
In Richland the fight over the school board started long before this election. Three MAGA school board members broke rules by holding a closed door session in the absence of their two other colleagues and the public to make policy on mask mandates—an undemocratic action which shook the city, resulting in a Democrat-led recall election. In Tuesday’s election, [all three recalled MAGA candidates](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/7fOlJbzdN/c?w=Ro-rDcFDVtFTsgaokkOuVL4c6zPVADhlANYg8jRUjqs.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cua3Vvdy5vcmcvc3Rvcmllcy9yZWNhbGwtdm90ZS1sZWF2ZXMtcmljaGxhbmQtaW4tbmVlZC1vZi1hLXNjaG9vbC1ib2FyZC1tZW1iZXIiLCJyIjoiZDMxNmUzOTMtYmM5YS00OTcwLThmZDItYmQ3M2JhZGQ1YjE5IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0), were replaced with three non-MAGA members who embrace democratic values.
In the small town of Sunnyside, a group of six residents decided that the status quo would not do and they set out to wrest MAGA’s grip from the City Council and School Board. In the boldest local campaign in memory they took their town by storm. Democrats were everywhere all the time and held numerous candidate forums to increase accessibility of voters. The four running for City Council won their seats and one of the two running for School Board won theirs.
It could not be clearer that Rural Americans United’s strategy for Central Washington of increasing the visibility and voice of Democrats and moderates is the best approach. With energized, active voters we can assert our individual rights and our belief in a truly democratic system that is fair to everyone.

body:
We have entered a perilous time for our democracy and institutions.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73394823/438377205/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjg4MWMzZWEtY2Q4My1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Tk_Asj6mapJB1WMM9CGaLto1ZxnuNs9Xa5ifPQtU3Es=&emci=c19b3f30-be83-ee11-8925-00224832e811&emdi=6881c3ea-cd83-ee11-8925-00224832e811&ceid=14016711)
**With the 2024 election cycle having already begun, it feels like we are careening toward disaster, Peter.**
Across the country, many are finding themselves exhausted and disillusioned with politics, government, and the institutions we once took for granted.
At the same time, trust in mainstream media outlets continues to slip as they prioritize rage clicks and profits over their duty to inform the public.
**The result?** Right-wing media and bad actors have launched a crusade to sow division and doubt in our institutions and democracy with targeted attack campaigns on the very concept of the truth.
_**But it doesn't have to be this way, Peter.**_
From the start, Courier Newsroom set out to ambitiously challenge both right-wing bad information and the mainstream media outlets that platform it by delivering well-intentioned journalism reporting on the issues that local communities care about.
[**We'll explain our critical role in helping to transform American journalism, but before we continue, please consider chipping in $5 or anything you can to power the journalism our democracy deserves.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73394827/438377216/1796093815?refcode=em20231115&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjg4MWMzZWEtY2Q4My1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Tk_Asj6mapJB1WMM9CGaLto1ZxnuNs9Xa5ifPQtU3Es=)
**The first step to revitalize our democracy will require us to _dramatically reshape_ our media landscape** to reach the majority of Americans who no longer consume media in the same way we used to. This won't be easy, but we must start this important work _now_.
That’s why our talented team of journalists works day in and day out to deliver their reporting to the online spaces where most Americans now spend their time.
By making our journalism easily accessible online to the communities we serve, we’re able to cut right through right-wing BS and misinformation, whereas traditional media organizations continue to fall short.
**At Courier, we’re leading the way in creating a new model of media that exists explicitly to protect our democracy. Here’s how:**
-** ** Over the past four and a half years, **we've built one of the fastest-growing networks **to reach Americans via their inboxes, TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram — the _same_ spaces where misinformation tends to spread fastest;
\- We're **expanding our reach **to 11 states (more on that soon!);
- **We're launching a new slate of creators, contributors, and products **to share our engaging content with a national audience that will continue our mission of holding mainstream media accountable, monitoring and confronting misinformation in real time AND;
\- Sharing updates from **key 2024 battleground states. **
**Countering the distrust and disillusionment in our democracy, to protect our democracy has to start with addressing America’s information crisis head-on and building new models of quality journalism to solve it, like we are at Courier.[And I hope you'll continue to support us as we work to strengthen and expand Democracy's Newsroom.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73394832/438377227/1796093815?refcode=em20231115&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjg4MWMzZWEtY2Q4My1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Tk_Asj6mapJB1WMM9CGaLto1ZxnuNs9Xa5ifPQtU3Es=)**
[Pitch In ➡️](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73394836/438377237/1796093815?refcode=em20231115&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjg4MWMzZWEtY2Q4My1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Tk_Asj6mapJB1WMM9CGaLto1ZxnuNs9Xa5ifPQtU3Es=)
Thank you for reading and as always thank you for supporting our work.
Tara McGowan
_Founder & Publisher
Courier Newsroom_

**In Case You Missed It:**
**We Should Be Thanking Chris Christie**
_“... Christie has defied expectations, running an error-free campaign, visiting two war zones, and performing well consistently. He has met the criteria to make the debate stage three times, has risen—albeit slightly—from the literal bottom of the polling heap, and convinced donors to fund this thing. In this last quarter Christie raised $3.8million, and not from bozos. Stanley Druckenmiller and several other billionaires see a purpose too; they’re not writing checks for charity.”_
[The Bulwark](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=4d29fc95f7&e=d0a9afa930)
AB Stoddard
November 15, 2023
“... Christie has defied expectations, running an error-free campaign, visiting two war zones, and performing well consistently. He has met the criteria to make the debate stage three times, has risen—albeit slightly—from the literal bottom of the polling heap, and convinced donors to fund this thing. In this last quarter Christie raised $3.8million, and not from bozos. Stanley Druckenmiller and several other billionaires see a purpose too; they’re not writing checks for charity. ...
“He is the only Republican running who is pummeling the voters with facts and truth—about lies, delusion, and crime. ...
“... He is doing more to stiffen the civic spine and protect democracy than almost anyone else...
“At the Florida Freedom Summit on November 5 in Kissimmee, the audience booed Christie from the time he walked on stage until he concluded his fifteen-minute speech. Christie gave it right back, pointing his finger and saying, ‘your anger at the truth is reprehensible,’ and warning, ‘the truth is coming.’
“Last week, he warned that a conviction is coming too. ...
“He added that ‘Nikki Haley, Ron DeSantis, Tim Scott, and Vivek Ramaswamy all raised their hand at the first debate’” to pledge to support a convicted Trump in the general election. Christie, of course, did not.
“’No one on that stage, other than me, will take him on, Christie [said](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=8ffdc669e6&e=d0a9afa930) after the third debate last week. ‘They’re running for either vice president or a member of his cabinet.’ ...
“... His resolve about Israel was as robust, and days later he visited Israel at the invitation of its foreign ministry.
“Watching Christie carry a bouquet of flowers in Moshchun, Ukraine, or sporting a flak jacket at the Israel/Gaza border would be worth a chuckle, the too-large Jersey guy without a suit jacket, if Christie were unserious, like Ramaswamy. But not only has Christie’s campaign been entirely devoid of photo ops, his views of both conflicts are earnest and authentic.
“... Although he cannot rehabilitate the Republicans who now make up Trump’s most committed base, he reminds them of what they used to champion—America’s indispensable leadership abroad, liberty, character, and the rule of law. ...
“I’m glad we got to hear what Christie has to say, and that the truth is coming. Play it on a loop.”
-###-

name: Grover Norquist
subject: How I discovered Ayn Rand
body:
Do you know how I was introduced to the ideas of Ayn Rand?

[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zl8tfu8elu5kssqlppi5el9aqa7ogfd34ui86muo_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1ge4o32cjh2bs)
Friend,

Do you know how I was introduced to the ideas of Ayn Rand? It took me longer than I'd like to admit.

When I was in high school, my teacher assigned a project where you were to read everything an author had written. I read Mark Twain, but a friend of mine read all the Ayn Rand novels. Unfortunately, I ignored her presentation and missed the point, but I remembered Ayn Rand's name.

In college, I would discuss free market ideas with other students. They kept on saying I must have read _Atlas Shrugged_ or that I was an Objectivist. This happened so often that I decided to investigate.

**So, I went out and read Ayn Rand 's novels and other writings.**

After that, I understood why people thought I was promoting Rand's ideas. _Because I was!_ I just didn't know it yet.

**While it took me until college to first read about Ayn Rand 's philosophy of Objectivism, one organization is finding innovative ways to introduce her ideas to the next generation at an earlier age -- The Atlas Society.**

They are bringing the ideas of Ayn Rand to new audiences through various vehicles, including animated videos, social media, virtual and live events, and graphic novels.

I told the CEO of The Atlas Society, Jennifer Grossman, that I would help her raise $30,000 online this week to provide graphic novels for even more students. **_Every $10 raised helps them distribute 5 new graphic novels_.**

**[Can you please send an urgent donation of $10, $50, or even $100 to The Atlas Society and help them bring these crucial novels to a new generation?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zne4e7td3bq3odleqt23o1vc50ujdsnajdn26ot0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1ge4o32cjh2bs)**
[Donate >>](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zg9as2c90cgtp6m8i22dse49ijmvfrnvf73l4en0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1ge4o32cjh2bs)

Ayn Rand's works reminded me of what was at stake.

What really hit me were the bad guys in Rand's novels. They weren't over-the-top villains. They were the ones who wanted to mess with the lives and businesses of the productive and place the blame for the consequences on capitalism.

I have met many John Galts, _but I have also met plenty of Ellsworth Tooheys_. Those men are real, and their envy-ridden ideology is what we need to fight.

The best way is to introduce the next generation to the moral case for Capitalism, to provide them with a guide to life that celebrates the remarkable potential and power of the individual.

The Atlas Society has plans to distribute 75,000 copies of their graphic novel versions of Ayn Rand's _ANTHEM_ and _Red Pawn_ this year -- and increase distribution to 100,000 copies next year.

[And with your support, they can reach that goal! Please rush your support today to help The Atlas Society distribute more graphic novels to young Americans.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zuqr37q036nl7od7chdp9t8apeh94q5vibq4s1t0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1ge4o32cjh2bs)

[Donate $10 & Distribute 5 Graphic Novel >>>](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zreq1rgfnf2krl1s9c149p05tsnv640db3rsv068_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1ge4o32cjh2bs)

[Donate $20 & Distribute 10 Graphic Novel >>>](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z30tcet4eqr0briac7btsje17i4k5feb15anpat8_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1ge4o32cjh2bs)

[Donate $50 & Distribute 25 Graphic Novel >>>](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zdc16b7eq5nr59u8lpt021dkuf61v9h673er2ug0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1ge4o32cjh2bs)

[Donate $100 & Distribute 50 Graphic Novel >>>](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z762q5372igbvmr41svnfrc68jkch6delq3b27q8_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1ge4o32cjh2bs)

[Donate $250 & Distribute 150 Graphic Novel >>>](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z0a9vg390hk1mkgs6c76lv92nvm02cav557kgou8_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1ge4o32cjh2bs)

[Donate $500 & Distribute 300 Graphic Novel >>>](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zlt9ee3027s0ce5momsu136lqe9hkna1tg829ul8_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1ge4o32cjh2bs)

They say that politics is downstream from culture, then what is culture downstream from? Philosophy!

Without a moral philosophy based on reason, achievement, individualism, and freedom, the next generation will continue to embrace a culture of irrationalism, entitlement, victimhood, collectivism, and resentment.

That's why it's so important to adapt Rand's works into a medium that appeals to the next generation. When I was a teen, 70% of my peers read books every day for fun -- _today, only 12% do_.

By contrast, comic sales have increased by nearly $300 million since 2011 and today represent a domestic market worth over $1 billion. Over half of those sales are graphic novels. The Atlas Society jumped on that trend, recruiting top Marvel Comics illustrating talent and bringing Rand's literature to life with vibrant art and action.

Ayn Rand's works reinforce that our fight is on principle. They teach us that everyone should be free to pursue their understanding of the virtuous life limited only by the prohibition of using force against others.

**If you have read Rand, then you are well prepared to have your freedom attacked by those who wish to control the lives of others.**

Your generous support will help The Atlas Society get Ayn Rand's moral ideas to more students by distributing copies of these graphic novels at Comic Cons, libraries, and homeschool groups. Please click below to donate today.

[Donate >> ](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z0ft6k7c9oud9pq8uq02kkk6k845rgovf0qfbkf8_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1ge4o32cjh2bs)

Thank you,

Grover Norquist

_The Atlas Society is a 501(c)(3) Not For Profit Organization. All donations are tax-deductible._

body:

Friend,

The Supreme Court just announced a new code of ethics [https://www.npr.org/2023/11/13/1212708142/supreme-court-ethics-code] amidst growing public outrage and Congressional scrutiny over undisclosed gifts.

But there's a catch. It fails to create any new requirements on gifts or disclosures, and it leaves compliance to the Justices themselves. Even Congress has stronger ethics rules than this!

Sign if you agree: The Supreme Court needs a real code of ethics. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/scotus-code-of-ethics-petition?contactdata=kSDEv/6sFXld66Se6p8/YlAAMPfKQoiDf8PCrs6en/C3fXw99oc2wzXg554j1PSYBuUEwaBlmn8HCiKMTSEBd9PMtH5LirbfXfIM+QYoNcz6kyQesomtveD8d/64k+WBwkMnVphnr/5bNWwBCwkMvg==]

https://twitter.com/RoKhanna/status/1724216787443601658 [https://twitter.com/RoKhanna/status/1724216787443601658]

The Supreme Court is one of the country’s most powerful governing bodies, capable of overruling decisions by the other two branches of the federal government. Without a comprehensive, enforceable code of conduct for its members, the Supreme Court will continue to hemorrhage public trust.

I will be introducing a sweeping anti-corruption political reform package that includes stronger judicial code of ethics for federal judges and Supreme Court Justices. It will also set 18-year term limits for Supreme Court Justices and 12-year term limits for members of Congress, ban campaign contributions of any kind from PACs and lobbyists, and prohibit stock trading by members of Congress and lobbying from retired members.

Sign the petition: The Supreme Court needs a stronger, enforceable code of ethics. Thank you for your activism and all that you do.

In solidarity,
Ro

Since forming OMG in March of this year, activity and investigations have been a whirlwind.

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpo2j1sq34kfbcvnjndl57b3u13s9029dnb4o8j0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1geco76chh2bs)

Dear Friend,

Since forming OMG in March of this year, activity and investigations have been a whirlwind.

We've exposed financial behemoth BlackRock for war profiteering in Ukraine, Best Buy for religious discrimination against Christians, school boards, Fox News, John Fetterman, CNN, Pfizer, and most recently, the payment processing giants who are funding our nation's elections with shady practices.

The pace at OMG is breakneck because our sources and whistleblowers are handing over so many relevant stories that it is becoming impossible to keep up!

I need to expand OMG's operations but to do that,**[I need your help.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9ga6h6tsb6vquak0ga5i5n472vdugvi93o2ksl0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1geco76chh2bs)**

Within the next ten days, I set a goal of raising $142,000 to cover the recruitment and hiring of much-needed staff that can help us keep and increase the pace.

**[Will you chip in today?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3o2tr8huhmt3qqctlp2hd2ub2hgl65iqh1b768g_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1geco76chh2bs)** Any amount gets me closer to our goal, and you will have my thanks.

OMG is controlled by NO ONE and funded by people just like you. We are beholden to no advertisers, special interests, parties, or candidates and take an absolutely independent outlook on reporting the truth to the American people.

Most importantly, we're able to BYPASS the filters of the media and report directly to you.

Our latest story on a massive campaign finance scheme garnered 1 million views on X (formerly Twitter) alone!

Different from when I first started my career in investigative journalism over a decade ago, getting people to watch isn’t the issue!

Our story-rich environment is the issue!

It reminds me of a story from Marine Corps history, and I wanted to share it with you.

During the Battle of Chosin Reservoir, Colonel “Chesty” Puller, an iconic Marine twice decorated with the Medal of Honor, found his Marines surrounded by Chinese troops and outnumbered 35 to 1.

Col Puller radioed in to give a situation report and calmly stated, _"We've been looking for the enemy for several days now. We've finally found him.**We’re surrounded. That simplifies our problem of getting to these people and killing them.”_**

While that may sound like bravado for those unfamiliar with Chesty Puller, it was far from it.

Puller and his Marines fought to the sea with ferocity and purpose, leading an Army Major General to state for history,_"The safest place in Korea was right behind a platoon of Marines. Lord, how they could fight.”_

My team at OMG is like those Marines; they are restless, diligent, and the best in their class. And we are also surrounded and grossly outnumbered.

Corruption never sleeps; it never rests, but it can only operate in darkness.

OMG’s purpose is to bring it to the light.

[**Please help me do that by donating today and helping us grow.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zq8ltef09smqe2gtujr5us5f507lfdvvunqjt1po_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1geco76chh2bs)

Thank you for your time and attention, and please [**support our operations and growth today.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3f464ta6htn5hs00iccm4f7b910n3kubvg7tvng_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c1geco76chh2bs)

In Truth,

James O'Keefe
Founder and CEO
O'Keefe Media Group

body:
| | |
---
I’m really excited to tell you about a new book from our good friend, Senator Ted Cruz! It’s called [_Unwoke: How to Defeat Cultural Marxism_](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjpudWxsLCJycSI6IjAyLWIyMzMxOS05YjY0M2U0ZjU1Yjc0MWE4YThiOGQ0NmE0MTNkMjE0MiIsInBoIjpudWxsLCJtIjpmYWxzZSwidWkiOiIwIiwidW4iOiIiLCJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudGVkY3J1ei5vcmcvdW53b2tlLz9taWQ9NDY1NjAmaWQ9VDE3VU5Uc2ZaSnR3a1N5VFRDIn0/QF_Z7J0OQGjrbv73bvZqzQ) _,_ and he couldn’t have written it at a better time. As our country is being overrun by cultural Marxists in what seems like every institution, we need to band together to defeat them. **A synopsis of the book...** Our institutions have gone "woke." Everybody knows that. But nobody has come up with a way to stop it. Until now. In this hard-hitting new book, Senator Ted Cruz delivers a realistic battle plan for defeating the woke assault on America. The Democratic Party is now controlled by Cultural Marxists. So are our universities and public schools, the media, Big Tech, and Big Business. Corporations push transgenderism down their customers' throats. Banks punish gun shops. Hollywood insults our religious beliefs and grooms our children. The big investment companies use our retirement savings to promote leftist causes. And the Biden administration has turned our military into an indoctrination camp, neglected transportation safety to focus on climate change, and persecuted peaceful pro-lifers while leaving prochoice arsonists at large. The son of Cuban immigrants who fled communist oppression, Cruz is uniquely equipped to fight the woke revolution. He eloquently explains how Cultural Marxism got a foothold in America, how it progressed, and how, in precise steps, we can fight back to regain our institutions, regain our country—and win the future for our children. Bold, practical, and necessary, _Unwoke_ is the book we need to restore the America we love. You can purchase the book on [Amazon](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.), [Books-a-million](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.), [Barnes and Noble](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjpudWxsLCJycSI6IjAyLWIyMzMxOS05YjY0M2U0ZjU1Yjc0MWE4YThiOGQ0NmE0MTNkMjE0MiIsInBoIjpudWxsLCJtIjpmYWxzZSwidWkiOiIzIiwidW4iOiIiLCJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmFybmVzYW5kbm9ibGUuY29tL3cvdW53b2tlLXRlZC1jcnV6LzExNDMxNTA2NTI_bWlkPTQ2NTYwJmlkPVQxN1VOVHNmWkp0d2tTeVRUQyJ9/dpwHKFVCdlolFhPtRkY48w), or directly from [Regnery](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-rKzVLV0AxeZMbJUI9Q). Let’s support one of our staunches Senate allies, as well as do what we need to do to defeat the cultural Marxists in our midst. In liberty, Jenny Beth Martin

clean_body: This is the single biggest threat to our elections. We must fix it before 2024. | | | Peter, did you hear about the absolute chaos in Maricopa County on Election Day? No, we're not talking about the 2020 election. Believe it or not, it happened AGAIN. This key county in a crucial swing state is seemingly incapable of running a secure election. This year's events were inexcusable: Polling locations were difficult for voters to find... Certain voting locations were closing well before the deadline... And officials seemed not to be following local election law... Voter Reference Foundation was founded to fight against election injustice like what was shown in Maricopa County. And with 2024 right around the corner, our mission has never been more important. Next year, some of the most monumental elections in our country’s history will take place, and we need to have confidence they will be secure, transparent, and lawful. With your help, we can ensure events like this never occur and secure future elections. Donate to our Secure America’s Elections Fund today to join the fight! | | Friend, File this under the messages I never thought I’d have to write. Former Speaker of the House Kevin McCarthy is apparently so enraged about his [ousting](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=717cb84158984de69d875229139edaef&_e=G21xViE_i4PPkWaWB2Zar2Xo_fBoE5iAT-TlT5XDUe5DZdNFvijJ3KaWXi9iYJzttO8NmpsdZDa_DEL5xarcgg_3ZG0nrumRHSiSUg7czlPI_eza5z3XP-S5GMWm8PDdOJ57WckS9wNfqZIITKi4sAcuxyiSDmSfX3o2mTEN7tRxoIMbl3Ynd_IThznxZotYL97cw9TU-oGdz0dpYqc4HJpayITKQNM9yJv2rqCcPM5zUqTHY5UanCfhhAjyj0pk98wnAPSSSq1wR0W585UnMnBs8MQxhKNbhpmVx1C59Y4%3D) that he’s willing to [get physical](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=717cb84158984de69d875229139edaef&_e=G21xViE_i4PPkWaWB2ZarzNOFncZATzSQ5uh7wmqe-gtPnQGPfxBYWkJHa1NEDAsYYqLgZiJrePWS1Awgxk9qskokgX06J1tFWh9DZJIMHmh3vBP9ADq8ZjOeZCQGmNFbHSilrzKhED6sLdJP0cYI7XsRWn5p-OWalkM1OwVX6EPp4n-mG2m3LZQt3oyD7zyrt-v7CVsF4guTq04nEMmpDwbSBSumkPR92_wQz8i1BtiGswczRtHMyMSNdAgQRU2_pv8KrKl0rwsEpZkGGCL1-SYAK5PiL5wtBXCtaRG_CdeCDVR4savQx38IpnPpHFK). In an encounter that is still shocking to me, Kevin strolled by and shoved me while I was talking with a reporter in the Capitol. Yep, you read that right. A grown man who has been elected by the people to serve in our nation’s capital is acting like a dadgum bully in a schoolyard. You all know me well enough by now to know that I’m not one to be pushed around, so yes, I [chased after him](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=717cb84158984de69d875229139edaef&_e=G21xViE_i4PPkWaWB2Zar9sskJUlg0bBMPh4A8g3HZtkO2jOwgLTTFOfBKLgWmPpH77nHbJDNu5tx0rrQfkEils7EwlkNEJY0PxpttLbWoBg2utepNU3OF9jcHhXx6jFVavMIFqyDCJObcE1Ikqs5iKvU2EYphFfmiM3SLneUodvGL6I-yOx_q2XydP12S9iqQU2rhn-tO5lGMfssATSPfn3rO-7n2z_WtASq8e4OJHOqE3AupR6zBnNqVBNH5XLZaoDxCBJrfn5TOoM3Xfa7F2QtvaiyXXpQpS7BJrwz7E%3D) to confront him about it. He denied his pathetic behavior, and I walked away with full confidence that replacing him was the right move. Not just for Congress, but for Americans. It was bad enough that Kevin mocked me over praying about my decision to vote the way I did, but this takes everything to a whole new level. Kevin McCarthy is a [jerk](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=717cb84158984de69d875229139edaef&_e=G21xViE_i4PPkWaWB2Zaryi0M9M0z7PmN1jAhsRq5K56o5No95axjMuqYAu1bi2jISuU_yH9KpkFrog43feyoP2Wa2gvARd1vz5RZt0P8HG2pQRdYWEUBX6MmiVing4UXV2O9fPcQLcFZa16Vxdg1xHmXhvZNfJQsmXRD-53_GqMizcyrV_cCLAanXZU0owM-4lebGfZxyADaHxzbKEiyFoSmkG_E-nsHLSKWkgml0Vva2Cxusq_Nz0WH_E6VxKz7HV65zDqQJOsFJaBeEmLUMOa4V9LqhLPKDXtKmPxmW9MoMdZwWqIs07oA3zQqPK_Y1OO6EieLRCdbh_fAcIv6A%3D%3D) on a downward spiral, and I’m not afraid to say it. We need leaders who take ownership and responsibility, not cowards who [pass the buck](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=717cb84158984de69d875229139edaef&_e=G21xViE_i4PPkWaWB2Zar0Yf5USKdIcakbX4K6fC1NB5QfbAhHsG-6GorAWQ8cpALghUQeMxawXtJzFzXIA5ziCz0UpKK3cPNaCfYSyEAf95BiTGu9MF7CIzHBVkNPxh8tq6YvWvYK6DOFkD3nwSE8UR_Zp1mTVxVg9PjEUjxAN2BCnu4sCstH-BKcrOQzo_dnYiRLYAk9qi7aK390Z7CmLK4Z9opNH_8VKEvo_jntyMK3XN_ZzzlBzlDALLZAqTBhzqpwK2AQhn5REfJRMH_961_3NtHVmEwPsW5mLwFCH4jnhLLexhNbczNjfqqe22) and refuse to look in the mirror when their shortcomings are exposed. Kevin doesn’t have the character to lead the House—and his knee-jerk reactions and attitude have made that abundantly clear. Even still, I feel sorry for Kevin. Despite his condescending attitude about my prayers, I send one up for him every day, and I hope he finds some happiness in his life. It’s been a wild year, but I’m confident that we’re finally headed in the right direction under [the guidance of Speaker Johnson](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=717cb84158984de69d875229139edaef&_e=G21xViE_i4PPkWaWB2Zar9aqAR_6dR-KRHyN5eagdoAC1T0bpy_wfqNPonkJg8o4iXh4n6YCp6bt9f9xi3d8RglXQj9tdEWK_ZNJLuZQ7IZne2Mo4qgIMO_MbtXtvMoK4X2jeHlp0VPp7zhIrM_KeJF-KH6ZmHGF-qZ65HsT-1BoOCoUg0LGR2i1tCNZE0zEc-faO3FzX9pxGpc4lGQGCuQ8pSi1zW9njNjBnSqiHghdO5Gb4lbltFYqEV9GMJWR88rbxRzbxD-J7qjzm8Iliw%3D%3D). We’re getting down to business and doing it the right way, and I will always stand by the decision I made to set this into motion. As always, thank you for your support, and thank you for sending me here. It’s a responsibility I don’t take lightly, and I always aim to make you proud. Sincerely, Tim Burchett

body:

November 15, 2023

[article-image]
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65827&L=30723&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY29jYWluZS1mb3VuZC1pbnNpZGUtd2hpdGUtaG91c2UvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNvcnJ1cHRpb24rY2hyb25pY2xlcyZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=d3671cc90d9d05f9cfea64e29e6a121289c8a418240fc6f1e19ff69ea358898b]

Judicial Watch announced recently it received 112 pages of Secret
Service records in a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request to the
U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) that show photos and
communications regarding cocaine found inside the Biden White House in
July. The DHS withheld 34 pages in their entirety under the
“foreseeable harm” standard, which states “the agency reasonably
foresees that disclosure would harm an interest protected by an

name: Hill Harper
subject: We’re not truly represented in Washington
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY HILL HARPER FOR MICHIGAN
body:
I believe that our government should work for the people, be a force for good, and protect our freedoms.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/130?refcode=em20231115-2&t=1&akid=575%2E62735%2EVQMePU)
**Peter, I wanted to take some of your time today to remind you exactly why we’re in this fight.**
We can all feel it, Peter. Whether you’re a driver, a nurse, a teacher, a construction worker, or a business owner, **_you’re not truly represented in Washington_**.
Now, I’m not a career politician. But when I see that D.C. politicians are delivering for special interests — instead of everyday people — it’s clear we need a system overhaul in Washington. And that means we need representatives who'll get money out of politics, and make our government work for _us_ again.
**That’s why I’m running to represent Michigan in the U.S. Senate!****I’m going to need your help to take on and defeat the special interests, so I’m personally asking:**
[**Peter, can I count on you to help us take this campaign all the way to Washington by pitching in $5 today before our fundraising deadline at midnight tonight?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hh-em-20231115-2?amount=5&refcode=em20231115-2-575&refcode2=575_62735_VQMePU&akid=575%2E62735%2EVQMePU)
**[Donate $5 today »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hh-em-20231115-2?amount=5&refcode=em20231115-2-575&refcode2=575_62735_VQMePU&akid=575%2E62735%2EVQMePU)**
As a union organizer, activist, single father, and the owner of a small business in Detroit, I understand the pressure Michiganders are facing right now:
* We pay **14 times more for a vial of insulin** than our neighbors to the north.

* We’re **49th in the nation in growth**.

* We rank **41st in the nation for teacher pay**.

* In the last three years, more small businesses **closed their doors for good** here than in _any other state_.

These challenges are not any single politician’s fault — it’s the system that’s broken. To change that, we need a new voice and a new perspective.
I believe that our government should work for the people, be a force for good, and protect our freedoms — not take them away.**But that won’t happen if we keep electing the same career politicians to office who will just uphold the status quo.**
And that’s what this campaign is all about — fighting for the future of ALL of our communities and our democracy.
**As a political outsider, I’m accountable to you from day one.** We won’t have the most endorsements from D.C. insiders, but we’ll have something better: A movement of everyday folks who are tired of our broken politics and ready to vote for dynamic change.
[**If you believe in better, please consider supporting our campaign by pitching in $5, $15, or more before our fundraising deadline at midnight tonight.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hh-em-20231115-2?amount=5&refcode=em20231115-2-575&refcode2=575_62735_VQMePU&akid=575%2E62735%2EVQMePU)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hh-em-20231115-2?amount=5&refcode=em20231115-2-575&refcode2=575_62735_VQMePU&akid=575%2E62735%2EVQMePU)**
Thank you for your support,
Hill Harper

name: Team Gallego
subject: We owe you an explanation.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
We need your help to catch up to our goals.
#

Peter, it’s Team Gallego.
Hope you’re doing well. Maybe you’re reading this at lunch, or you’re taking a little break. Maybe you’re hanging out at home.
Wherever we find you today, we felt like we owed you a quick explanation about what a mid-month deadline is, and why it’s so important to a campaign like ours.
At the end of every quarter we hit an official FEC deadline. When it hits, we need to report what we raise to the FEC, and that report goes public. The next FEC deadline is on December 31st — New Year’s Eve.
That means we’re just about halfway to our next FEC deadline.
Internally, we set benchmarks every month towards that quarterly deadline. And right around mid-month, we assess our progress to those goals. These goals aren’t arbitrary. They are what we need to raise to win this race.
If we’re on track, we’re in good shape. If we’re ahead, we can raise our goals and make new investments. But if we’re behind, we need to push a little harder to catch up. And if we don’t catch up, we need to make budget cuts that could harm our chances at victory.
This month, we’re behind. November is always tough, but we’re having an especially hard time making progress to our goals this month. And that’s why we’re emailing you again today.
We need your help. We’re hoping that being transparent and reading you in on what these deadlines really are will encourage you to help us hit them. And with so much happening lately, it would mean a lot if you could chip in.
So we’re asking, very humbly:
[**Please, make your first contribution to Ruben Gallego’s Senate campaign in Arizona before our mid-month deadline at midnight tonight.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov23.azuTO_&refcode=em231115-2&t=1&akid=1443%2E734936%2E75Oa2y)
[CHIP IN BEFORE MIDNIGHT](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov23.azuTO_&refcode=em231115-2&t=2&akid=1443%2E734936%2E75Oa2y)
Thanks a lot for your help.
Team Gallego

Fellow American, This is the first and last email I'll ever send you.

You see, I'm a little unsure about opening up to you this way.

**But the deck is stacked against us, my back is against the wall, and your response to this message will decide everything. **

My name is Pat Harrigan. You don't know me, but I'm a Green Beret veteran from North Carolina. I graduated from West Point, and I served 18 months in combat.

After that, my wife and I started a firearm parts company from our double-wide trailer - and grew it to become a successful, job-creating business. And most important of all, I'm the dad of two beautiful girls.

**I 'm also a GOP candidate in the MUST WIN race in NC, a district that WILL decide who controls Washington. **

Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden already have $100 million bucks ready to trash our GOP candidates in every swing district on the map.
---
[**That 's why I'm humbly asking if you'll chip in just a few bucks today.**](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=025b9019db2842fc816f69f10a5d7760&_e=W92mhFHmLwIampwRn_CSFG914Cni8Z9UIyARkUQeq4XZ4AxY2_M2AraoKDP67cf2q3xNlRLGmM9J28DI2nMeKfKDRN3r8L1SjjiSnw_Ci4GcFqVt5IbN1JnGfnHIV0EL1HVNOugQVr01YLwms-KcheL2ESmhvZj9q2_iDquVCtt02VR2-SKUMj8rHATqwzmsmvF35xUNF5AHk0iGIwyNlpJrqc2S8gi439eVqaJrWLgfsO7ROaOyjo7t6ALylz8MHFvWG8mXYM09keAUlPEe3c8nUa5JYkNIFsTJXs7Oh4gH9IofPlX90O4X_sGnNA0d6nxePqGzXyU1-mUgDy6akNFNdbevO76kR2SwGW5gwM8%3D)

Fulton County, Georgia District Attorney Fani T. Willis is holding a fundraiser on Wednesday, 11/15, in Washington, D.C., about 650 miles from her Atlanta office. The fundraiser is for her re-election campaign so she can continue to persecute President Donald Trump in Fulton County.
I've obtained an image of an invitation revealing the fundraiser's location as 1301 K St NW 1000, East Tower, Washington, D.C. 20005. This location is better known as One Franklin Square, a high-rise built in 1990 and the home of the Washington Post since 2015. It's strange enough that Willis is holding a fundraiser so far away from her Georgia jurisdiction, but why is it sharing a building with the far-left Washington Post, which has a long history of endorsing Democrat political candidates, including Joe Biden, Hillary Clinton, and Barrack Obama?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5d55a490-faea-460d-8845-5ce055a78778?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The invitation shows a minimum suggested donation of $250. Different tiers of donors show that a "Friend" can donate $500, a "Supporter" can donate $2,500, and you could be a "Chair" by donating $6,600.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a74174b3-b13e-4ce1-a195-3015df175fa3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Fani Willis has been at the helm of the political persecution of President Donald Trump in Fulton County. She's using Georgia's RICO statute, which is intended to bring down organized crime, on Trump and 18 alleged co-conspirators in supposedly attempting to influence Georgia election officials in 2020. Trump was indicted in Fulton County in August 2023, giving him one of his most powerful tools in his 2024 presidential campaign: his iconic mugshot.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c06009de-8204-4341-b8a7-3f2fa56085ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I've also discovered that Alan Scott Bolden, a race-baiting, leftist lawyer, is hosting the fundraiser. Bolden acted as a defense attorney for former Baltimore State Attorney Marilyn Mosby. Still, he ultimately withdrew from her defense in 2023 after he violated the court's local laws by divulging confidential juror information, filing a motion without a Maryland attorney's signature, and using profanity on the courthouse steps while accusing the U.S. Attorney's Office in Maryland of racism.
District Judge Richard D. Bennett said Bolden's actions were "abhorrent," and many felt he should be convicted of criminal contempt. Last week, Mosby was found guilty of two counts of perjury for making false statements on loan applications for two Florida vacation homes, the Justice Department said. Bolden doesn't want her to admit her crimes. Because Mosby is black, he used the defense of "attacks on Mosby are racist" because Bolden seems to think that black people are immune to being held accountable.
Additionally, Bolden is the former chairman of the DC Democrat Party. In an interview on Fox News, Bolden said that it was "smart" for the Left to indict President Trump during an election year, and that Trump's GOP Primary opponents are banking on Trump being jailed.
Given these facts, it is wildly inappropriate for Fani Willis to be attending this fundraiser.

I say “policy is personal,” because, for me, it is.

I was born and raised in Spring Valley, New York, by a single mother who worked multiple jobs to keep food on the table. Even though she worked around the clock, we still needed Section 8 housing and food stamps to get by.

When child care was too expensive, I often went to work with my grandma, who worked well past the age of retirement cleaning homes, while my grandpa worked as a janitor at the local middle school.

I was lucky to be raised by a hard-working family, which did everything it could to provide me with what I needed. But life wasn’t always easy, and I often think about what a profound difference affordable child care, health care, and better wages would have made in easing the burdens on my mother and grandparents.

Despite our circumstances, my mom always taught me to dream big, and that’s exactly what I did. I’m here running to return to Congress to keep fighting for families like mine and ensure _everyone_ has the opportunities and resources to not only survive, but to thrive.

body:
#
It’s November 15th, and tonight marks the official mid-point of our quarter. So I am reaching out personally with an update on our fundraising progress.
When my team emailed you yesterday about our mid-quarter deadline, we weren't quite sure how much support we would get — or whether we'd reach our goals ahead of tonight's critical fundraising drive.
But we have a solid chance.
It started with Faithe from Milwaukee with a $20 donation. Then Judy from New York joined with their $50. And later, David from San Geronimo chipped in $10.
Now they're all hoping that you will join them, and I am too. Because there's only one way we'll continue powering our movement for changemaking candidates...if we work together.
I know that $3 doesn't seem like the kind of money that can help us hold the Senate majority and Presidency and win back the House, but this team has won big victories before — in the Wisconsin Supreme Court Race and just last week in Virginia’s legislative races — and I have no doubt we can do it again.
Whether it be unseating Ted Cruz in Texas, replacing Krysten Sinema in Arizona, or re-electing Tammy Baldwin in Wisconsin and President Biden in the White House, we have the power to create meaningful change if we work together. Because it all adds up when everyone is chipping in.
So I am asking you directly:
[**Can you make a $3 contribution to The Long Run before our mid-quarter fundraising drive comes to a close TONIGHT at midnight?**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-nov23.S9Wq-Z&refcode=em231115-1-t2&t=1&akid=5006%2E196590%2EFDFocz)

| More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

| [](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=26f8607043104c108900ff3a660cb7f6&_e=eEfrdk28bO5jGEk9AhWCSXgsveHt3_NCBP-mG7xo5qQu7uzhH9OUPOE2pe8lhvvY3lUdDF311QvieDilTOugN7faaXMHYVA73opqY8-3xftR2vpLqsOoNIgJ-_NaDsRHN6zdCu1UYbjOKpwPHnAtwF8JohC3D_Jn_JS8vzLZ8I-msrc4IlstjlbsytOWJNMqRyF4QUF4zkCG3_YHFkGR_pNCdCHarrrWUyv_jSnMQMc2Sjp7hmaaVGDodlVJ8gb-25sZNV61anorS7BQwRXAu8XNnANP3tvygCGM-7c1jk1XJS5lZcI63yS4KzGZoYRE)

Peter,

I wanted you to be among the first to see the [**national news**](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=26f8607043104c108900ff3a660cb7f6&_e=eEfrdk28bO5jGEk9AhWCSXgsveHt3_NCBP-mG7xo5qQu7uzhH9OUPOE2pe8lhvvY3lUdDF311QvieDilTOugN7faaXMHYVA73opqY8-3xftR2vpLqsOoNIgJ-_NaDsRHN6zdCu1UYbjOKpwPHnAtwF8JohC3D_Jn_JS8vzLZ8I-QiUPVAD5HnrrXTMX9YOUJcaHP0QpIDRalMrRaT0duRnJLOFIW0CjIH27PtKYl3bWLpxdMOV5ENRXGfpl4zGLRjz-stLx3I9oSK146dwZjNxEtkpy6r7puoBGQuwG1eYIaCP10OOOV2CLkAfE9wRXe) of my latest endorsements because they mean so much to me.

This year our entire nation has seen that Columbiana County personifies resilience, hard work, and grit. When the derailment occurred, local leaders and first responders stepped up. They didn't take 'no' for an answer. They worked together to hold intergovernmental leaders, agencies, and private companies alike accountable, and they demanded results. It's the kind of leadership that makes Ohio and America great, and I'm honored today to announce their support. In the U.S. Senate I will never stop working to build upon their progress and deliver results for East Palestine, Columbiana County, and our entire state.

Matt Dolan [](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=26f8607043104c108900ff3a660cb7f6&_e=eEfrdk28bO5jGEk9AhWCSXgsveHt3_NCBP-mG7xo5qQu7uzhH9OUPOE2pe8lhvvY3lUdDF311QvieDilTOugN7faaXMHYVA73opqY8-3xftR2vpLqsOoNIgJ-_NaDsRHN6zdCu1UYbjOKpwPHnAtwF8JohC3D_Jn_JS8vzLZ8I-uP4nNZeJn2Txc7yLLsvXHsR8uU2oqrz_Kek8Kpy52oQEwDHNLXoEGFkNAarYN62y1lx4rf6Gwn86tKAqL9mo8ZIZP1zWfPkfLE44_rsGQ0fwt9r7zlu0xHnPGVuco4CFzuYx0ofI2W2-8Pz3ujQD1)
Political leaders in a small Ohio town that was thrust into the national spotlight earlier this year after a train derailment triggered the release of hazardous materials are making an endorsement in the state's competitive GOP Senate Primary in a race that could determine if Republicans win back the chamber's majority.

East Palestine Mayor Trent Conaway and fire chief Keith Drabick, as well as Columbiana County Commissioner Tim Weigle, are endorsing state Sen. Matt Dolan. The announcement was shared first with Fox News on Wednesday.

East Palestine Mayor Trent Conaway, in backing Dolan, said in a statement that "in the aftermath of unspeakable tragedy, Ohioans came together from many walks of life to lift one another up and begin a recovery process that continues today. Through it all, one leader among many has stood out for his efforts grounded in responsiveness and results."

"Matt Dolan didn't come here for headlines, cameras, or social media clicks. He quietly showed up, rolled up his sleeves and asked how he could help. Each day, Matt has stood with East Palestine and as we continue to rebuild, he's focused on our community's needs and worked with us to develop a recovery plan that gets results. That's why I'm proud to stand with Matt Dolan," Conaway emphasized.

Keith Drabick, the town's fire chief, highlighted that Dolan "cares about results, not who gets the credit. He's taken the time to come here, visit with our people, understand our challenges, and get to work in a manner that serves others. We need more leaders like Matt Dolan."

And Columbiana County Commissioner Tim Weigle said that Dolan "has taken a personal interest in the rebuilding and success of our community, and that makes him exactly the kind of proven public servant we need in Washington."

President Trump visited East Palestine after the derailment and praised the mayor's efforts. The town is located in Ohio's Mahoning Valley, which is considered part of the Rust Belt, where working-class voters predominate. Trump made major gains for Republicans in an area, which previously was a Democratic stronghold.

Learn more about Matt Dolan's campaign for U.S. Senate at [**www.dolanforohio.com.**](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=26f8607043104c108900ff3a660cb7f6&_e=eEfrdk28bO5jGEk9AhWCSWbg6gzLkt4Q2k1ewAn-CwRFJfKUk36kihktC9TsduQXHTNKrUlKK7ZDn_25HF1m_Por6_eeRuKWYoPbuDfUPls_N67j4aqBc6cXk0auDO5yzOCzwuLGUUjxFOajk5v6AiZD11Fhm8VNO5AIPGWdJug5hQocs-5CCCrlkk_ddMYgrvf2dY3qV_CprBbh-bLevQ%3D%3D)

They didn't take 'no' for an answer. They worked together to hold intergovernmental leaders, agencies, and private companies alike accountable, and they demanded results. It's the kind of leadership that makes Ohio and America great, and I'm honored today to announce their support. In the U.S. Senate I will never stop working to build upon their progress and deliver results for East Palestine, Columbiana County, and our entire state. Matt Dolan Political leaders in a small Ohio town that was thrust into the national spotlight earlier this year after a train derailment triggered the release of hazardous materials are making an endorsement in the state's competitive GOP Senate Primary in a race that could determine if Republicans win back the chamber's majority. East Palestine Mayor Trent Conaway and fire chief Keith Drabick, as well as Columbiana County Commissioner Tim Weigle, are endorsing state Sen. Matt Dolan. The announcement was shared first with Fox News on Wednesday. East Palestine Mayor Trent Conaway, in backing Dolan, said in a statement that "in the aftermath of unspeakable tragedy, Ohioans came together from many walks of life to lift one another up and begin a recovery process that continues today. Through it all, one leader among many has stood out for his efforts grounded in responsiveness and results." "Matt Dolan didn't come here for headlines, cameras, or social media clicks. He quietly showed up, rolled up his sleeves and asked how he could help. Each day, Matt has stood with East Palestine and as we continue to rebuild, he's focused on our community's needs and worked with us to develop a recovery plan that gets results. That's why I'm proud to stand with Matt Dolan," Conaway emphasized. Keith Drabick, the town's fire chief, highlighted that Dolan "cares about results, not who gets the credit. He's taken the time to come here, visit with our people, understand our challenges, and get to work in a manner that serves others. We need more leaders like Matt Dolan." And Columbiana County Commissioner Tim Weigle said that Dolan "has taken a personal interest in the rebuilding and success of our community, and that makes him exactly the kind of proven public servant we need in Washington." President Trump visited East Palestine after the derailment and praised the mayor's efforts. The town is located in Ohio's Mahoning Valley, which is considered part of the Rust Belt, where working-class voters predominate. Trump made major gains for Republicans in an area, which previously was a Democratic stronghold. | | Peter,

I want to sincerely thank you and each one of my loyal supporters for standing with me as we fight the good fight for freedom, and I want you to know that you are not alone... So far in my campaign, I have been blessed to receive a number of endorsements by prominent members of party, leaders of our country, and organizations alike who stand with us in our cause.

Among the list of individuals who have officially endorsed my candidacy, are patriots such as; _**Alma Jackson**_ \- _Former Vice Chair of the Texas GOP_ , _**Moms for American Action**_ , _**Luisa Deason**_ \- _Fmr. Public Affairs Officer for ICE, and _GOP Chairs of; **_Medina_** , **_Uvalde_** , **_Bandera_** , **_Bexar_** , &** _Denton_** \- _GOP Precinct and County Party Chairs._

I am humbled by the endorsement of so many noble leaders in our party, and their support will go a long way in securing victory, **but that victory is not possible without another vital endorsement,** **__yours, __ Peter? _._** I am running to represent all district members, Texans, and Americans who believe in defending our conservative values, so it is critical that I have you standing with me in this fight so that we can win this race for our people.

Below is a complete list of all my endorsements, with one notable exclusion, **on the bottom line there is a blank space** _**_for you to add your name,_**_**Peter?**__ , and join the fight for our freedom. **We need you today, will you join the cause?!**

No thanks to Scott Perry, Congress has avoided another threatened government shutdown. Yesterday, 209 Democrats joined just 93 Republicans (not including Perry) to pass temporary spending bills. Perry and the Chaos Caucus he leads pouted about spending on things he doesn’t like.

Running for NJ-08 is not a step back, but a leap forward. In this new chapter, we will continue to fight for the values we hold dear: integrity, accountability, and commitment to the welfare of our community. Our campaign will focus on addressing the everyday challenges we face, from healthcare and education to cost of living and environmental sustainability.
Your support is the backbone of our campaign. As we embark on this new journey together, I am counting on your help. Together, we can make the change NJ-08 deserves—a representative who not only listens to the needs and aspirations of our community but someone who lives them alongside you.

| | | Hi Peter, We want to hear your Owyhee stories! What inspires you to protect the Owyhee Canyonlands? Have you visited them? Tell us about your time spent in the Owyhee Canyonlands. [Submit your story to be featured on OLCV’s blog and social media pages.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/73427324/438455779/-959356660?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU2ZGM0ZWU4LWZhODMtZWUxMS04OTI1LTAwMjI0ODMyZTgxMSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=sVw6rJBcNybiyTXBcs1vVOvYXxthpBpQLZYMozcPGnk=&emci=8ee55262-df83-ee11-8925-00224832e811&emdi=e6dc4ee8-fa83-ee11-8925-00224832e811&ceid=2107230) Tomorrow (11/16), Senator Wyden’s bill to establish permanent protections for the Owyhee Canyonlands, the Malheur Community Empowerment for the Owyhee Act (S 1890) could get one step closer to becoming a law. It’s up for a vote in committee! This bill is supported by local ranches, hunters, conservation groups, tribal communities, and more-- yet a [recent article published by the Oregonian](https://click.everyaction.com/k/73427325/438455780/-721132465?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU2ZGM0ZWU4LWZhODMtZWUxMS04OTI1LTAwMjI0ODMyZTgxMSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=sVw6rJBcNybiyTXBcs1vVOvYXxthpBpQLZYMozcPGnk=&emci=8ee55262-df83-ee11-8925-00224832e811&emdi=e6dc4ee8-fa83-ee11-8925-00224832e811&ceid=2107230) shows Congressman Cliff Bentz opposes it. That’s why we need your help to show through stories the importance of protecting this special place. The Owyhee Canyonlands took millions of years in the making, and they now face looming threats that could change them forever — unless we protect it. [**Share your story about the Owyhee Canyonlands to help show Congressman Bentz and others how deserving this region is of permanent protections.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/73427326/438455781/-959356660?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU2ZGM0ZWU4LWZhODMtZWUxMS04OTI1LTAwMjI0ODMyZTgxMSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=sVw6rJBcNybiyTXBcs1vVOvYXxthpBpQLZYMozcPGnk=&emci=8ee55262-df83-ee11-8925-00224832e811&emdi=e6dc4ee8-fa83-ee11-8925-00224832e811&ceid=2107230)
Photo by Kevin Smith As someone who has only seen pictures and videos, and heard stories-- I’m inspired to protect the Owyhee Canyonlands for their sheer natural beauty. I’m also motivated to protect this region to help save the Greater sage grouse, which is under consideration to be listed under the Endangered Species Act. I’m fascinated by these unique birds, and would love to see one in person someday. My Owyhee story is just getting started, and the next chapter is establishing permanent protections. When I eventually visit, I’d like to be able to say that I helped protect it. [**What’s your Owyhee story?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/73427327/438455782/-959356660?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU2ZGM0ZWU4LWZhODMtZWUxMS04OTI1LTAwMjI0ODMyZTgxMSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=sVw6rJBcNybiyTXBcs1vVOvYXxthpBpQLZYMozcPGnk=&emci=8ee55262-df83-ee11-8925-00224832e811&emdi=e6dc4ee8-fa83-ee11-8925-00224832e811&ceid=2107230)
