In order to take back the House, we need to start laying the groundwork right now | | | Peter — Last week, we proved the pundits wrong _again_ when progressives won big across the country. But with 2024 on the horizon, we can’t let up, not even for a minute. **The 2024 cycle starts in earnest right now — and one of our highest priorities will be to take back the House from Republican control. And the path to retaking the House runs straight through New York state.** That’s why we’re joining a new coalition of labor unions, activist groups, and powerful organizations to target six vulnerable Republicans — including Reps. George Santos and Mike Lawler — who represent some of the best pick-up opportunities not just in New York, but nationwide.1 Together, we plan to make millions of calls and door-knocks in each district. But in order to win, we need to start laying the groundwork right now. **[Will you contribute $10 or whatever you can afford to help us flip these districts and take back the House from Republicans?](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYUzKLNxMuEuapl7Bfsmycdo8r3cBlAx7fy8y57tnwg4ygT9u5Ol5xRcJldbkWZPoFa3sGy4R_U_KNq-WB5NrdDzr4qipE39Nn-hnF6sZhWs-5GmRUY8f5PF3lD2kVf7J77ZaOrmO0PAc3RXY1Nm1iOOyxCK8ktrpitXsgXQhwtVg1ewbqG5FJyX1a0GfuaZAfdvV2_tcobW9HB2ke3TTN72I4qtTMbGfcTYr6Jnf7Uq2CSwwDaGrE4CFpWSRIWIOKF47uUiH24an1h7PwF2s_nrO5hmF9Iz8mPUFMjhQ9IOt0zGup87zBtcPizkxd6ya5lIFViR2uaT3iwEt40H0ZWkQ/41b/xN5jQxBCTz-WnM-eGeaPlg/h0/nvWME7EsnzWWmypQqGVxsT_oDjCxYlQVld9qUZpijF4)**
**[Contribute $10 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYUzKLNxMuEuapl7Bfsmycdo8r3cBlAx7fy8y57tnwg4ygT9u5Ol5xRcJldbkWZPoFaDpjeSFdCSKKe1vs9cFxnrA04Dr9ccC--XTwZPo7HUQhUNT0lPFNBLZJDAxzt8Ajgt8-0iLwoRTNKX-L_XJebZPcm-H7GziEHziJ8BZJJiOtzr0HhMr7YQkJV8JLU3Li4Hyi6XLezpEOY_RjUCMAPJztjdLWPNASxFDFMdqW3S2_bQ7FA65RIq_nmvV0UbC_x_7K6Igvjw1kA5hOAZhjtAzm20NjyA8bbnt0GTiWL_1UtkBARjNsoWtJgPDnHZuY8TmnPHSX9dBH-jei_opFxBw/41b/xN5jQxBCTz-WnM-eGeaPlg/h1/cCFbvZLyBo2HG52bSb3AqoAxHHKsRCMGGQopG53s2fs)** **New York may not be the first state that comes to mind when one thinks of a typical battleground state.** But in 2022, Republicans were able to flip the House in large part by taking advantage of newly drawn districts and under-resourced candidates across New York. Since then, we’ve seen just how much damage Republicans can do when they are in control:
* They’ve held the country hostage with constant threats to shut down the government;
* Their constant infighting within their own caucus led to complete chaos and brought the House to a standstill for nearly a month;
* They chose as their new Speaker MAGA extremist and election denier Mike Johnson, who wants to pass a federal ban on abortion, called LGBTQ+ people "sinful" and "destructive," and played a central role in efforts to help Trump overturn the will of voters after the 2020 election.

**The one thing we haven’t seen from the Republican Party is any willingness to govern or do anything to help working people.** Yet despite their dysfunction, we know we have our work cut out for us. If we’ve learned anything in the last two election cycles, it’s that early engagement with voters is crucial. Which is why we can’t delay — we need to get to work now to flip the House in 2024. clean_body: In order to take back the House, we need to start laying the groundwork right now | | | Peter — Last week, we proved the pundits wrong again when progressives won big across the country. But with 2024 on the horizon, we can’t let up, not even for a minute. The 2024 cycle starts in earnest right now — and one of our highest priorities will be to take back the House from Republican control. And the path to retaking the House runs straight through New York state. That’s why we’re joining a new coalition of labor unions, activist groups, and powerful organizations to target six vulnerable Republicans — including Reps. George Santos and Mike Lawler — who represent some of the best pick-up opportunities not just in New York, but nationwide.1 Together, we plan to make millions of calls and door-knocks in each district. But in order to win, we need to start laying the groundwork right now. New York may not be the first state that comes to mind when one thinks of a typical battleground state. But in 2022, Republicans were able to flip the House in large part by taking advantage of newly drawn districts and under-resourced candidates across New York. Since then, we’ve seen just how much damage Republicans can do when they are in control: They’ve held the country hostage with constant threats to shut down the government; Their constant infighting within their own caucus led to complete chaos and brought the House to a standstill for nearly a month; They chose as their new Speaker MAGA extremist and election denier Mike Johnson, who wants to pass a federal ban on abortion, called LGBTQ+ people "sinful" and "destructive," and played a central role in efforts to help Trump overturn the will of voters after the 2020 election. The one thing we haven’t seen from the Republican Party is any willingness to govern or do anything to help working people. Yet despite their dysfunction, we know we have our work cut out for us. If we’ve learned anything in the last two election cycles, it’s that early engagement with voters is crucial. Which is why we can’t delay — we need to get to work now to flip the House in 2024. We need to start now to build a sophisticated get-out-the-vote effort in each battleground district in New York in order to defeat Republicans and take back the House for working people. In solidarity, Team WFP Source: 1\. , The Washington Post , November 9, 2023 Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. In 2022 alone, the U.S. experienced over 44,000 gun-related deaths and 645 mass shootings.

#
Derek:
Let me put the bottom line upfront: I am running for Governor, and I need your support! **[Will you split a contribution between my campaign and VoteVets today?**](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-nov23-spanberger.scr7kp&refcode=em231115-1-30&t=1&akid=19446%2E3013755%2EVoih7D)
Now, let me tell you why: Years ago, I swore my first oath to our Constitution. I enthusiastically embarked upon a journey and a career of public service — first in law enforcement and then at CIA. I worked at home and abroad to keep our country safe and protect the country I love.
When my husband Adam and I moved our three daughters home to Virginia – just miles from where we had grown up – I thought my days of public service had come to a close. But after the 2016 election, our country was at a crossroads, and I envisioned what it could be if we flipped Virginia’s 7th District and made clear that the people of our district deserved stronger representation. I worked hard, we built an extraordinary team driven by purpose and principle, and in 2018, our district elected a Democrat – me – for the first time since 1968.
I have served proudly through some extraordinarily consequential moments in our history, and I have endeavored to do right by my constituents every day. I am proud of the work I have done, the laws I have passed, and the difference I have made.
And now, our Commonwealth is at another crossroads – do we continue moving backward with attacks on our rights, our kids’ education, and our communities’ sense of security — or do we move forward on a path of progress? Last week, Virginia’s elections showed that Virginians want to move forward, but we need a new Governor to be driving that progress.
I am running for Governor, because I know what I will bring to the job – a deep and abiding love for our Commonwealth, a relentless work ethic, and a focus on bringing people together to solve the real challenges facing Virginians.

| | **For Immediate Release:** November 15, 2023
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**LGBTQ+ Advocates Endorse Dave Min**
_Largest Statewide LGBTQ+ Civil Rights Organization In The Nation
Backs Sen. Min For CA-47 _
**IRVINE, CA** — Today, the nation's largest statewide LGBTQ+ equality and civil rights advocacy group is endorsing Dave Min for California's 47th Congressional District. With a tenure in the State Senate marked by thoughtful allyship, Dave Min has been a longtime champion for LGBTQ+ issues. He has stood loudly against LGBTQ+ hate and hate of all kinds, having hosted over 200 anti-hate events, and was proud to [stand with the community in Huntington Beach](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=474608a898&e=7017cc100e) this year when the city council banned the LGBTQ+ Pride Flag from city property. The announcement comes days before Sen. Min is [slated to be endorsed by the California Democratic Party](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=e820080412&e=7017cc100e), having won a commanding 72% of the early vote last month.

**"Equality California proudly endorses Dave Min for Congress, recognizing his unwavering commitment to LGBTQ+ rights and social justice,** said Jorge Reyes Salinas, communications director for Equality California. ** “In a time marked by divisive policies and targeted attacks on marginalized communities, Dave Min stands out as a dedicated ally. His career reflects a consistent effort to ensure that every individual, regardless of their background, sexual orientation, or gender identity, can live without discrimination and enjoy the full rights they deserve. We know Dave Min will be a champion for LGBTQ+ equality in Congress, and we look forward to working together to create a more inclusive, diverse, and just society for all." **

Equality California is the largest statewide LGBTQ+ advocacy organization in the country, representing over 900,000 members. Their stated mission is to bring the voices of LGBTQ+ people and allies to institutions of power in California and across the United States, to strive to create a world that is healthy, just, and fully equal for all LGBTQ+ people, and to advance civil rights and social justice by inspiring, advocating, and mobilizing through an inclusive movement that works tirelessly on behalf of those we serve.

**"I'm humbled by the endorsement from Equality California, an organization at the forefront of the battle for LGBTQ+ rights and social justice,”** said State Senator Dave Min. **“In a time when too many extremists are trying to target our marginalized communities with divisive and hateful policies, Equality CA has stood as a beacon for progress, advocating for inclusion, diversity, and a more just society. I’ve been proud to stand as an ally of our LGBTQ+ community throughout my career, fighting to ensure that every individual, regardless of their background, sexual orientation, or gender identity, can live free from discrimination and with the full rights they deserve. I’m grateful to Equality California for their trust in me, and look forward to continuing to work closely with this amazing organization.”**

Equality California is a welcome addition to a large and diverse coalition supporting Min, who launched his campaign for CA-47 in January with the support of incumbent Congresswoman Katie Porter, and announced his campaign’s early endorsement by the Service Employees International Union (SEIU) and the California Federation of Teachers. Over the course of this year, Senator Min has built a coalition of support that includes over 125 local, state, and federal officials, including California Lt. Governor Eleni Kounalakis, Attorney General Rob Bonta, and three other California statewide elected officials, AAPI Victory Fund, Asian American Action Fund, the Asian American and Pacific Islander Congressional Caucus’s ASPIRE PAC, which represents 21 members of Congress, and many others. A full endorsement list is available [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=95240c00d3&e=7017cc100e). ###

_California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. _

body:
Years ago, I volunteered to serve in our nation's military, and nothing could shake the indescribable sense of pride I gained from those years. I was called to serve, and I will never stop.
---
| | | | | | | | | | [](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=acb4f68a6858462aaa003683c4af1d0d&_e=uEgQNJGw06ZAjPhidCUzDUEpx8zGQ0Wq0WVIADTuqzKnt2nlA6aFlHojhxOOl62cVEYBypIH5KWaCONPAreuvbywntEWBG707NzauDD1WjLu1-_c_D0hmpGO0uKKHRnjzd1ZRwmHw6aTX4ZZmmK7ftOtSpCdU1YfW_ooRSKM858eJcbnbaVGPKlk-cDNeDz-n2hWrSDaOxplghiicRq-Yv3h2tfs5RprDaqLLt04t6pKxiI2twYPIfWO7hsLmOggGBqjKHnnfGR7yjpddvuY5qEKtfAd2IVl5kvyY4zpHI9ywPPUNKpSk1D3tljVLnH6YQdLAsySbXgqpWy2Sv0AkgEnsQwb-rzBNrZjpTZPrQzi5N4pilbGfxiPmLlaZb6T7b4WJwo9uSZtp82plFx_GTh3yZ7p18V-m-CzIe22WZLJj4xm5MmnPHg3RzNzx4NY0bwJu7-dr01PcZfZTzldYQ%3D%3D)
---
Friend, If you've heard my story, you know that I went from being a blue-collar kid in Florida, to attending Yale on a baseball scholarship, to working my way through Harvard Law School... all leading up to the day I saw our freedom come under fire on September 11th, 2001, and volunteering to serve in the proudest fighting force in the world. When I deployed to Iraq with U.S. Navy SEAL Team One, I put on the cloth of my country, shipped out with a sense of confidence, conviction, and patriotic duty to our nation, _and served with undying honor._ Fighting for this country has always been personal to me, and I will hold that honor close to my chest for as long as I live.
---
| | | | [](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=acb4f68a6858462aaa003683c4af1d0d&_e=uEgQNJGw06ZAjPhidCUzDUEpx8zGQ0Wq0WVIADTuqzKnt2nlA6aFlHojhxOOl62cVEYBypIH5KWaCONPAreuvbywntEWBG707NzauDD1WjLu1-_c_D0hmpGO0uKKHRnjzd1ZRwmHw6aTX4ZZmmK7ftOtSpCdU1YfW_ooRSKM858eJcbnbaVGPKlk-cDNeDz-n2hWrSDaOxplghiicRq-Yv3h2tfs5RprDaqLLt04t6pKxiI2twYPIfWO7hsLmOggGBqjKHnnfGR7yjpddvuY5qEKtfAd2IVl5kvyY4zpHI9ywPPUNKpSk1D3tljVLnH6RJmH0dvPYLfQlYxxEayjnfSbO5dQBNqx9Pt9dkTZDgc98RUY1AOLZKtbcrYV-ZahLX5DfxWMixIEh8aBhEWGqeYNqGtB21h2fRtr-rTgI9J1W8-51ZOT28ecBELBgJy4ZK0rRE37FyYbS_k_rMHJYg%3D%3D)
---
| | [](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=acb4f68a6858462aaa003683c4af1d0d&_e=uEgQNJGw06ZAjPhidCUzDUEpx8zGQ0Wq0WVIADTuqzKnt2nlA6aFlHojhxOOl62cVEYBypIH5KWaCONPAreuvbywntEWBG707NzauDD1WjLu1-_c_D0hmpGO0uKKHRnjzd1ZRwmHw6aTX4ZZmmK7ftOtSpCdU1YfW_ooRSKM858eJcbnbaVGPKlk-cDNeDz-n2hWrSDaOxplghiicRq-Yv3h2tfs5RprDaqLLt04t6pKxiI2twYPIfWO7hsLmOggGBqjKHnnfGR7yjpddvuY5qEKtfAd2IVl5kvyY4zpHI9ywPPUNKpSk1D3tljVLnH62ipmuYl8bAzNq7SM9apFZYVVd-NUSRCUcP4KLmzfeuPAzxdDKG8wCwuI_WeHxxxQykFWe3TFWBu7LaKZvYxSCCtLUOBqdPlPyWiNVBPfsmKLI6q7XUi__2K99NwwmNUnKasSNW6KSQaGICxCKOt7Vw%3D%3D)
---
As the only veteran in this race, I feel a responsibility to step up and lead with the conviction I'll never shake from my time in the service. I believe our country deserves a Commander-in-Chief who truly understands what we're fighting for and what we're fighting against. _The gravity of the situation we're now facing is nothing short of_** _dire_** _._ Our nation's once-proud fighting force has been infected and paralyzed by a political agenda, our military recruitment levels have reached an all-time low, and yet we are expected to salute our "Commander-in-Chief," Joe Biden. Not only is this a slap in the face to the veterans across this country, but it is an insult to _every_ soldier who has come before our time:
* Those 56 men who pledged their lives in Independence Hall in 1776 so that they could create a new nation conceived in liberty.

* Our nation's first Republican President who stood at a cemetery in Gettysburg and pledged this nation to a new birth of freedom.

* That band of brothers who stormed the beaches of Normandy, defeated the Nazis, and saved this world.

As a veteran, as a former Congressman, as Governor, and as a father, I have remained steadfast in my devotion to reminding those who will listen of the words of Ronald Reagan: **_Freedom is one generation away from extinction; it's not passed along in the bloodstream, and it must be protected and cultivated._** Today, I am humbly asking you for support to help me fire Joe Biden and restore**this mission and sanity, pride, integrity, and capability** to the chief office of our military.
---
| | [Support my campaign for President](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=acb4f68a6858462aaa003683c4af1d0d&_e=uEgQNJGw06ZAjPhidCUzDUEpx8zGQ0Wq0WVIADTuqzKnt2nlA6aFlHojhxOOl62cVEYBypIH5KWaCONPAreuvbywntEWBG707NzauDD1WjLu1-_c_D0hmpGO0uKKHRnjzd1ZRwmHw6aTX4ZZmmK7ftOtSpCdU1YfW_ooRSKM858eJcbnbaVGPKlk-cDNeDz-n2hWrSDaOxplghiicRq-Yv3h2tfs5RprDaqLLt04t6pKxiI2twYPIfWO7hsLmOggGBqjKHnnfGR7yjpddvuY5qEKtfAd2IVl5kvyY4zpHI9ywPPUNKpSk1D3tljVLnH6l_Y-8vTOkgskoHOabwNq-UgbKkGVFhIWY3G8_U6Kax4gLdbaLOWj_nqgxX-K2A4yvoLZubAYWhXkuTq5-zaaiPYNhr4hrZbyxJ9V0FIs66sdWo6DuNEIsLbMGqkGdYtG-jOvwW1sF8nmPaLky_5IyA%3D%3D)
---
And Friend, I am also asking you for one more thing. Please, as our freedoms continue to come under fire every day that we allow Joe Biden to sit in our Oval Office, choose to stand on the side of freedom today, and always. I need you fighting with me.

Yours in Freedom,
---
| [](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=acb4f68a6858462aaa003683c4af1d0d&_e=uEgQNJGw06ZAjPhidCUzDUEpx8zGQ0Wq0WVIADTuqzKnt2nlA6aFlHojhxOOl62cVEYBypIH5KWaCONPAreuvbywntEWBG707NzauDD1WjLu1-_c_D0hmpGO0uKKHRnjzd1ZRwmHw6aTX4ZZmmK7ftOtSpCdU1YfW_ooRSKM858eJcbnbaVGPKlk-cDNeDz-n2hWrSDaOxplghiicRq-Yv3h2tfs5RprDaqLLt04t6pKxiI2twYPIfWO7hsLmOggGBqjKHnnfGR7yjpddvuY5qEKtfAd2IVl5kvyY4zpHI9ywPPUNKpSk1D3tljVLnH6aIOijToDtBwD0XMtmNVT5HfYrtgDGvKxl813gi4D4T7N9z4HiRx0RJsTCRC5LrmMggNpcZBzuPxK4aeFdpuEh8Yi6HLjdL-EMmrLfEU3s-SFcJrrj5A6XrgGiX_bJZHT4e3Pfxvzl2eNIw2KNZp7aw%3D%3D)

_**Get to Know Ron DeSantis**_

| | | [](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=acb4f68a6858462aaa003683c4af1d0d&_e=uEgQNJGw06ZAjPhidCUzDUEpx8zGQ0Wq0WVIADTuqzKnt2nlA6aFlHojhxOOl62cVEYBypIH5KWaCONPAreuvbywntEWBG707NzauDD1WjLu1-_c_D0hmpGO0uKKHRnjzd1ZRwmHw6aTX4ZZmmK7ftOtSpCdU1YfW_ooRSKM858eJcbnbaVGPKlk-cDNeDz-n2hWrSDaOxplghiicRq-Yv3h2tfs5RprDaqLLt04t6pKxiI2twYPIfWO7hsLmOggGBqjKHnnfGR7yjpddvuY5qEKtfAd2IVl5kvyY4zpHI9ywPPUNKpSk1D3tljVLnH6MFWeWutlPP29EJpR31gLCs_3-7dc2XcLcxuUeF-E9V7wD3QFaYOoxfky8U9uL34nK_BDHq6ICBxsUVycwVuRYv7leHMtik_AlWUGlr23zDv8xmuSzzagoEIlzeIbfsgX6gKgh9x-GqYywRr4ugK5qg%3D%3D)
---

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

---
| [](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=acb4f68a6858462aaa003683c4af1d0d&_e=uEgQNJGw06ZAjPhidCUzDUEpx8zGQ0Wq0WVIADTuqzKnt2nlA6aFlHojhxOOl62cVEYBypIH5KWaCONPAreuvbywntEWBG707NzauDD1WjLu1-_c_D0hmpGO0uKKHRnjzd1ZRwmHw6aTX4ZZmmK7ftOtSpCdU1YfW_ooRSKM858eJcbnbaVGPKlk-cDNeDz-n2hWrSDaOxplghiicRq-Yv3h2tfs5RprDaqLLt04t6pKxiI2twYPIfWO7hsLmOggGBqjKHnnfGR7yjpddvuY5qEKtfAd2IVl5kvyY4zpHI9ywPPUNKpSk1D3tljVLnH6_XapF7RwIM11sNfW0Fme9EBf3fSMgV6HfL7rYu6LHWv43TW_7f2ft3b2I0UNXS_GOcTc44nor1uy6W03wmNdTTWNkeebMxEe3ZB1G2N1mLLDXkvIsVYLlIJT67jJe-9Z4iETHUlKE3zntu0_LR7e4g%3D%3D)
---

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

| **SENATE REPUBLICANS ELECT LEADERSHIP TEAM** MCLEAN, VA, 15 NOVEMBER 2023: Virginia Senate Republicans today elected their leaders for the 2024-2027 term. Senator Ryan T. McDougle (R-Hanover) will serve as Republican Leader, Senator Mark D. Obenshain will serve as Republican Caucus Chairman, and Senators William M. “Bill” Stanley, Jr. (R-Franklin) and Bryce E. Reeves (R-Orange) will serve as Republican Whips. “I am honored my colleagues have elected me to serve as Republican Leader,” said Senator McDougle. “We have a talented team of experienced lawmakers and skilled newcomers who are prepared to advance our positive agenda of fighting inflation, lowering taxes, supporting law enforcement, and getting energy prices under control. We will be working collaboratively with Governor Youngkin to promote his priorities, and we are determined to thwart partisan obstructionism.” “The people of Virginia elected a narrowly divided General Assembly,” noted Senator Obenshain. “Like the House, the structure of the Senate should reflect that. Republican senators are ready to get to work, ensuring the voices of the over four million Virginians we have been entrusted to represent are heard. I am grateful to my fellow Republican senators for electing me Caucus Chairman, and I look forward to working with all of them to advance our shared positive conservative agenda for Virginia." "I am immensely proud and ready to take on the role of Republican Whip in the Virginia Senate," said Senator Bryce Reeves. “It is an honor to have the trust of my colleagues as we work together to address the pressing issues facing our great Commonwealth. With a team of dedicated lawmakers, both seasoned and new, we are poised to advance a positive agenda that resonates with the needs of our constituents. I am eager to work with my fellow Republican senators to ensure the voices of Virginians are not just heard but actively represented in our efforts to build a better future for all.” ###

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

clean_body: Whether you’ve been with me from the start or this is the first time you’re hearing about me, I couldn’t be more grateful to have you on board. | | | | | | | | | Hi Fellow Conservative, Whether you’ve been with me from the start or this is the first time you’re hearing about me, I couldn’t be more grateful to have you on board. With election season kicking into high gear, I think it's important to take a few minutes to introduce myself and talk about the journey I have been on. "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!" Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. | | It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them. | I launched my campaign for President over six months ago because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class. Now, I completed my THIRD debate, and I need a SURGE of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign before this next debate. >> " Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days. Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today in support of my fight to save America? | | | | | | | | | | Fellow Conservative, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. Friends,
Did you catch the news story about the voter fraud allegation in Lawrence, Massachusetts. READ IT HERE: [https://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-12753891/footage-stealing-ballots-Massachusetts-mailbox-voter-fraud.html](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00106b8WJVRgRZY00pOwfxhx-3YbQELL-JJSeuDrRql3bato34TI3YYOYxGOJIAOmYQj-r_IukaOvbJfjKFZLLJ06BEQ5aXH1jQ8HanRLqDytXi7KG9T_PthYcti7aiA_MbsZ3iZoY5u5HncXSpIxnXCwZJ_t3dpcI4KdmmG7eBvaeiOpsv-XTShQj_ptx1bNzRHJA_DNAaEHUdmJz2JgYMnGOChWeX3WJvTzT4-VzMA3cZqPRKUJTxFEjHUwny-xQKJBzt9Z-SbXmIGrrYcf9Y86YkrqbJrhRAvPNUuan2rLwd4HbjBg5IpG6fNyp6WsUBZ1sHwysqvMA=&c=neSPB0ZTQkuZlRZRIUbYpivc1zlKuzOavStQRbmc4MAby47tqBiZLA==&ch=XB595uTlOBTDhtu4E8sMLkqwg_AoaAVDHhkNXKLDbfaFJvq7xeRfng==)
According to the news report, a Lawrence man went to vote and was told he already had voted. When he took a look at his porch camera, he saw someone taking his ballot application out of his mailbox. This is exactly why we need VOTER ID! Voter ID will prevent this type of thing from happening right here in Massachusetts!

This is where you come in. We Need Your Help to make VOTER ID a reality in Massachusetts by collecting signatures and signing our petition. The deadline is quickly approaching, and we need 74,516 certified signatures by November 22, 2023. Our goal is to collect 90,000. It is not too late to help with our effort!

We will be out collecting for the VOTER ID ballot initiative in your area. Check for a location near you here! [https://ma4voterid.org/#28d75879-b66e-453b-91e0-53aa3ec62f40](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00106b8WJVRgRZY00pOwfxhx-3YbQELL-JJSeuDrRql3bato34TI3YYOeePU--4uVCvXWzRx_tJ1szV-QJmMhAtDaFDuKUxdIBDt3TKxPo3wA3bQZanW2OWuKrMMDDliEElZcKWSsfxVaOReZ1ZyMxOSLuxyVFrSGusSnSHZcoZPmP53THjRrW5No6VwWsIlE7s-ZfNZ-9qyLrkuQE3j08SO_pMbw34VKtJEAf6KjnXtvrbF_zW08bDtjLGQt0GNSCE&c=neSPB0ZTQkuZlRZRIUbYpivc1zlKuzOavStQRbmc4MAby47tqBiZLA==&ch=XB595uTlOBTDhtu4E8sMLkqwg_AoaAVDHhkNXKLDbfaFJvq7xeRfng==)
You can download and print the petition by clicking here:[https://img1.wsimg.com/blobby/go/be866505-7f0f-420a-96e8-da5e5d596dc8/downloads/Voter%20ID%20Petition.pdf?ver=1700103030559](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00106b8WJVRgRZY00pOwfxhx-3YbQELL-JJSeuDrRql3bato34TI3YYOYxGOJIAOmYQvFxteDVGRqzyDK43xHxj6oNMZ-0GdLEOBSMBDc2Tj60fVK1ZPv2e7CQKWjN8RJDkZx9QbB3rQ9kRnnFvyAwrN9xEobA41tJ5RzvhBNAbCRZOibWuIUnriMGVSL2_elV_CXFpYbphTbWm_ZPylyOddK2zaFynvfHDHwRJ2ftkBO7Ou7kkd2hZVIS0CEuYCMQcse8CA8bpQxnVgiKSMuzrb8ZrpoI_FQFC18E6EscZ4N41dlHrPfBkx4ws9Tob0gWtO-AYRoxg8vJwINuL36sipjYG-ix-5aCPsxNeRkPwVL8=&c=neSPB0ZTQkuZlRZRIUbYpivc1zlKuzOavStQRbmc4MAby47tqBiZLA==&ch=XB595uTlOBTDhtu4E8sMLkqwg_AoaAVDHhkNXKLDbfaFJvq7xeRfng==)
Follow the instructions and mail it to the PO Box on the front of the petition. Print a copy out for friends and neighbors to sign. Take a sheet to work. But please mail it ASAP as we must have all petitions in our hand by November 21, 2023

We will be at various locations throughout the state. If we want fair elections we must take a stand for election integrity, voter ID is a huge step in that direction.

Thank you, Caroline Colarusso

clean_body: Democrats keep winning on abortion. Texas should take note. Republicans keep losing elections, Peter. Democrats defied expectations in last week’s off-year election. In Ohio, Virginia, Kentucky and elsewhere, Democrats won ballot initiatives, state houses, and governor’s seats— and it’s because abortion rights were on the ballot. Americans were appalled by the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe. But they’re even more appalled by the Republican attempts to ban abortion in states across the country—and they’re ready to hold Republican lawmakers accountable. I’m going to explain how we can recreate this success for Democrats in TEXAS.= **= Peter, since Roe was overturned last year, Democrats have continued to overperform when abortion rights are on the ballot. For example, in Ohio last week, voters overwhelmingly passed a ballot initiative to protect abortion rights. But that’s not an easy task in every state, including in Texas, where amendments must receive two-thirds support in the Legislature before being put in front of voters. But make no mistake: abortion rights are on the ballot in Texas. After Roe was overturned, Republicans in Texas passed one of the most strict abortion bans in the nation. It was signed by Gov. Abbott and supported by Sens. Ted Cruz and John Cornyn. It’s on all of us to remind voters that Texas Republicans—those in the Legislature, the Governor’s mansion, and in the halls of Congress—took away their abortion rights. That’s exactly what Team Casar is working to do every day. = Together we can end the abortion ban in Texas and restore reproductive rights for 30 million Texans. Thank you, -Greg Greg Casar Congressman Texas Congressional District 35 ****=** | ****** ---|---

| Peter,

Like many, my partner Paolo and I came of age at a time when being gay was still considered a crime in many states.

I often reflect back to when I was 17 years old in the wake of 9/11. I had a deep sense of duty to serve the country, but policies like “Don’t Ask, Don’t Tell” discouraged me from joining the military.

Thanks to the brave LGBTQ+ Americans who came before me and had the courage to come out, I eventually got the chance to work openly in law enforcement and counterterrorism. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73430975/438468251/1013293294?amount=3&refcode=MTFC_20231115_EMSPL_E1_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM2MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMGZmOGM4MS0wNjg0LWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Kn0p03vatmFidV8ewca7_z4zTf3sEwui4H3PlphfjOc=) _Paolo and I recently at Palm Springs Pride._ Despite the strides we've taken toward equality, the recent election of Speaker Mike Johnson proves the GOP is hell-bent on turning back the clock on LGBTQ+ rights.

Johnson’s record reads like something out of an anti-LGBTQ+ hate group’s wish list. Aside from voting against marriage equality just last year, he:
* Is on record supporting the criminalization of sexual acts between consenting LGBTQ+ adults,
* Previously worked with an organization that pushed so-called conversion therapy,
* Claimed that a ‘homosexual agenda’ will destroy society and likened being LGBTQ+ to pedophilia and bestiality. _Really._

The fact that the Speaker of the House doesn’t respect Paolo's and my right to love is shocking -- especially in 2023. And the fact that Ken Calvert and the entire Republican Party handed him the Speaker’s gavel is even more horrifying.

We can send a clear message that rejects Johnson’s hateful agenda by turning the House blue next year. That starts by flipping CA-41.

clean_body: | Peter, Like many, my partner Paolo and I came of age at a time when being gay was still considered a crime in many states. I often reflect back to when I was 17 years old in the wake of 9/11. I had a deep sense of duty to serve the country, but policies like “Don’t Ask, Don’t Tell” discouraged me from joining the military. Thanks to the brave LGBTQ+ Americans who came before me and had the courage to come out, I eventually got the chance to work openly in law enforcement and counterterrorism. = Paolo and I recently at Palm Springs Pride. Despite the strides we've taken toward equality, the recent election of Speaker Mike Johnson proves the GOP is hell-bent on turning back the clock on LGBTQ+ rights. Johnson’s record reads like something out of an anti-LGBTQ+ hate group’s wish list. Aside from voting against marriage equality just last year, he: Is on record supporting the criminalization of sexual acts between consenting LGBTQ+ adults, Previously worked with an organization that pushed so-called conversion therapy, Claimed that a ‘homosexual agenda’ will destroy society and likened being LGBTQ+ to pedophilia and bestiality. Really. The fact that the Speaker of the House doesn’t respect Paolo's and my right to love is shocking -- especially in 2023. And the fact that Ken Calvert and the entire Republican Party handed him the Speaker’s gavel is even more horrifying. We can send a clear message that rejects Johnson’s hateful agenda by turning the House blue next year. clean_body: We’ll fight back even harder to ensure that voters can make their voices heard — and we need you with us. | | | After the 2020 census, each state redrew its congressional and legislative district lines to be in line with population shifts. You’d think that’d be the end of the process, right? Not so fast. Anti-voter lawmakers tried to weaken Black political power by manipulating redistricting. That’s illegal. States like Georgia, Alabama, Florida, South Carolina, and Ohio have found their maps in court. And now, in a victory for democracy, a federal court has ordered the Georgia legislature to re-do its maps to truly represent the diversity of our state’s electorate. Make no mistake: Gerrymandering is part of a larger national agenda to try to block representation for marginalized groups and push ballot access further out of reach. All so power-hungry leaders can cling to power. As extremists inevitably try to design additional unfair maps, we’ll fight back even harder to ensure that voters can make their voices heard — and we need you with us. = | = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- Two weeks from today, Georgia lawmakers will start their special redistricting session. The fact that the court ordered this do-over reflects an important principle: Voters’ right to fair representation remains intact. It’s a win for Black voters and our democracy, representing a significant step toward ensuring the true voice of the people can, and will, be heard. But our work isn’t over. Together with partners in the Peach State, Fair Fight Action is calling on legislators to conduct the work in public, allow Georgians time to review and provide input on the maps, and end gerrymandering that disadvantages minority voters. We’ll keep working to make sure voters can make their voices heard — but we can’t do it all without you. = Thank you for your continued support, The Fair Fight Action Team = | * 1270 Caroline Street | Suite D120-430 | Atlanta, GA 30307 ©2023 Fair Fight Action - All rights reserved. Peter,
I recently received the renewal notice for my campaign’s PO Box, and it reminded me of one of the first big spending decisions I had to make as a first-time candidate back in October of 2021. Should I rent the PO Box for six months – enough time to receive mail through the Primary? Or for a full year, and operate with an intent to make it to the November General Election?
This may seem like a low-stakes call, but it was a big deal at the time. Unlike many candidates, I don’t come from wealth – and as rewarding as the work is, being a meteorologist doesn’t exactly pay millions. What it ultimately came down to was whether or not I believed in our campaign, and that our grassroots support would be strong enough to make it beyond the first election. Truthfully, I wasn’t sure. I was born and raised in this district. I served the residents of Illinois’ 17th District as a meteorologist for years, helping the people prepare for their days. But would that lead to them trusting me to represent us in Congress, fighting on behalf of each of us for lower healthcare costs, reproductive freedom, and the safety of our communities? **I rolled the dice that day, and opted for a year’s lease of the PO Box — and we made history.** It has been my greatest honor to serve West and Central Illinois in Congress. Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.
Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

name: Alexandra Rojas
subject: BREAKING: AIPAC plans to go “all out” to unseat the Squad next year.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Breaking news, Peter:

AIPAC plans to go “all out” and spend $100 million to unseat the Squad
next year.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231115-2.DxUi58&refcode=em20231115-31874&t=1001&akid=31874%2E1203867%2ExDWyGB ]Slate headline: The Squad is About to Fight for its Political Life

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231115-2.DxUi58&refcode=em20231115-31874&amount=3&t=1002&akid=31874%2E1203867%2ExDWyGB ]We need to start preparing for this fight IMMEDIATELY. Can you rush
$3 or more to Justice Democrats right now to help us defend
the Squad from AIPAC?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231115-2.DxUi58&refcode=em20231115-31874&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=31874%2E1203867%2ExDWyGB ]Contribute $3

In light of Israel’s genocide against Palestinians, and the Squad’s
unified calls for peace and a ceasefire, AIPAC is preparing to spend big
money on primary challengers against each of these progressive incumbents
in an attempt to unseat them and replace them with centrists who will
uphold the status quo.

AIPAC spent $25 million in 2022, but Slate reports they’re preparing to
quadruple that spend in 2024. They’ve already recruited moderate
candidates to challenge Cori Bush, Summer Lee, Ilhan Omar, and Jamaal
Bowman, but are reportedly “still feverishly recruiting” opponents for
Rashida Tlaib, AOC, and Ayanna Pressley.

Slate also points out that “small-dollar fundraising numbers are way down
across the board, making it even more difficult for those progressives to
fund a defense.” That’s where you come in.

If we’re going to mount a defense against this corporate- and
Republican-funded, anti-Palestinian lobby group that’s going after our
entire bloc of progressive, diverse incumbents in Congress, we need more
grassroots donations from people like you.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231115-2.DxUi58&refcode=em20231115-31874&amount=3&t=1022&akid=31874%2E1203867%2ExDWyGB ]There has never been a bigger threat to the Squad and our movement for
progress. Please chip in whatever you can to directly support our work to
re-elect each and every Squad member in 2024 →

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231115-2.DxUi58&refcode=em20231115-31874&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1041&akid=31874%2E1203867%2ExDWyGB ]Contribute $3

The Squad needs us now more than ever, and we need them if we’re going to
keep up the fight for a ceasefire, Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and
so much more.

I know this is a lot of money, and we know we can’t raise $100 million
like they can quickly, but we have overcome being outspent before. And we
can do it again if we come together to protect what we’ve built these last
5 years. It’s in our hands.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in
Israel and Palestine: please urge your member of Congress to support a
ceasefire through [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139873?t=1042&akid=31874%2E1203867%2ExDWyGB ]Adalah Justice Project’s petition or by calling them
using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1043&akid=31874%2E1203867%2ExDWyGB ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20231115-31874-footer&t=1044&refcode2=31874_1203867_xDWyGB&akid=31874%2E1203867%2ExDWyGB

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1045&akid=31874%2E1203867%2ExDWyGB

A proverbial Chinese curse invites an unfortunate listener to "live in interesting times." That's a fair way to describe an era of escalating crisis or unfolding collapse.
From [political chaos](https://substack.com/redirect/240fd9c6-6a06-4382-b407-010b3024f7da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Washington, to the [genocide in Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/b45ebbfd-75e9-4f20-bc93-e66b1762e5ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) enabled by occasional [unanimity](https://substack.com/redirect/296cc46c-8a27-49c0-b245-47bc60dbb15e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) supporting a [bipartisan](https://substack.com/redirect/11c812ab-85d6-435e-8d44-14d620098681?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) commitment to [militarism](https://substack.com/redirect/2f33f230-fc89-41a8-96c2-587ef99b9103?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a steady and accelerating [erosion of independence](https://substack.com/redirect/9229dbdc-73ca-4a1f-9764-e0edb0d10ea4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) across the entire field of journalism makes it all possible. So many problems have emerged to confront our society that it can seem bewildering to merely name (let alone meaningfully investigate) them all.
If nothing else, this kind of velocity in current events offers plenty of opportunities for observation. Life is rarely boring for writers--especially in times like these.
### That's how the cookie crumbles
I spent a few days over the weekend pulling together a post that I was about to publish last night, before discovering at the last second that events ultimately overcame my predictions and required revisiting my central thesis.
The piece I had written focused on how a litany of crises crowding the news cycle had distracted the public from a predictable crisis developing on Capitol Hill, where a government shutdown [had loomed](https://substack.com/redirect/8875e3f4-14a2-4851-817b-cf62e0d84484?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as early as this Friday.
Looking at the [recent history in Congress](https://substack.com/redirect/240fd9c6-6a06-4382-b407-010b3024f7da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), it seemed far from likely that a deal could be reached to continue funding the government. Former Speaker Kevin McCarthy (R-CA) was [removed by his own caucus](https://substack.com/redirect/2b0e1f09-c348-4ef9-b180-a4b9050dde8a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after reaching a bipartisan agreement with Democrats, and nothing substantial has changed in the weeks since then beyond the [election of his right-wing successor](https://substack.com/redirect/240fd9c6-6a06-4382-b407-010b3024f7da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
On the one hand, I was right that current events continue to seize public attention and polarize public discussion. Yet, despite [my prediction of a lingering logjam](https://substack.com/redirect/2b0e1f09-c348-4ef9-b180-a4b9050dde8a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Congress, it seems that policymakers were actually able to get their act together for once this Tuesday night.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5aca343c-57e4-431c-8708-83a0b6d5510e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Image by YuiHarunaShinozaki licensed through [Creative Commons](https://substack.com/redirect/c8424a6d-9356-44ec-a087-00cf6a98fd9a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), available at [https://www.deviantart.com/yuiharunashinozaki/art/Quickgold-Chuck-meme-678849530](https://substack.com/redirect/d06cdbb7-dee4-477b-b61a-ec4a121e849c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### What the deal means
On the one hand, the [House approving a bipartisan measure](https://substack.com/redirect/7bbfa8fe-57a6-472e-af4f-5896e136f51b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to continue funding the government might seem like a political victory for Republicans, and particularly new Speaker of the House Mike Johnson (R-LA). After all, had the government shut down so immediately after his election to the Speakership, it would have defined his time in the office and likely limited his political capital going forward.
But that would be the wrong lesson to take away.
If anything, [Johnson is walking in his predecessor's footsteps](https://substack.com/redirect/d9eb6755-3340-4c39-a95b-ef7286a47715?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by relying on support from Democrats. He relies no less than McCarthy on the continued support of the extreme fringes of his caucus, while ironically courting Democrats--who can plausibly claim a political victory themselves, since the Continuing Resolution approved by the House lacks the spending cuts to government programs long sought by Republicans.
Know anyone else interested in current events? Share this post with them!
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=138898175&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTM4ODk4MTc1LCJpYXQiOjE3MDAwODk0MDEsImV4cCI6MTcwMjY4MTQwMSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0._9dkDPw3C0yFQO0vC2LdsHXMxtnf6epkxxpkqYbe8G4)
Ultimately, the biggest beneficiary is the American people, if only because government shut downs always prove so [catastrophic](https://substack.com/redirect/8875e3f4-14a2-4851-817b-cf62e0d84484?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to recipients of federal benefits and public programs relying on federal support.
[Politics will continue](https://substack.com/redirect/2b0e1f09-c348-4ef9-b180-a4b9050dde8a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to offer melodrama on Capitol Hill, and the news cycle will remain crowded for the foreseeable future--but at least one mess has been cleared off the table for the rest of 2023.
In all honesty, I'm glad that my prediction of unrelenting dysfunction in Congress has been proven wrong, for the moment.
Then again, the new Continuing Resolution funds some government agencies only until late January, and others through early February--so we will likely be right back here again in just a few months.
Stay tuned, and thanks for reading!

body:
Dear Texas Voters,

[image: tre-hat.jpg]
I’m Dr. Tre Pennie, and I am reaching out to you with a sense of purpose
and determination. As a Doctor of Education, a 22-year retired Dallas
Police Sergeant, U.S. Army veteran, and national law enforcement advocate,
I have dedicated my life to serving and protecting our community.

This week, I proudly filed my candidacy for U.S. Congress in Texas
Congressional District 3. I am driven by a deep commitment to make a
positive impact on our community and address the pressing issues that
affect us all – rising inflation, growing violent crime, border insecurity,
riots, social media threats, and the influx of fentanyl, endangering our
children.

*Learn more at: www.pennieforcongress.com
<https://list2.trepennie.com/c/27/2/12/5>*

[image: kickoff-video.jpg] <https://list2.trepennie.com/c/[CLICK_EMAIL_ID]/6>

*Video: Tre Pennie campaign kickoff event October 5
<https://list2.trepennie.com/c/27/2/12/7>*

It’s time to prioritize the interests of The People over politicians that
are controlled by lobbyists.

Over the past year, we’ve witnessed unprecedented chaos in Congress and
observed the ineptness of our District’s current leadership. Now, more than
ever, we need change and a competent voice who understands how to take
charge and navigate the dysfunction in Washington.

[image: congress.jpg]
The growth in our district cannot be stifled by political agendas that seek
to defund the government with no real policy. There needs to be an educated
approach to how we address politics in our district—one that focuses on
building a safer, stronger community for everyone.

I need your support to help bring about this change. Together, we can build
a future where our community thrives, and the voices of The People are
heard.

Click here to contribute to our campaign:

*Donate to Tre Pennie for Congress!*
<https://list2.trepennie.com/c/27/2/12/1>

Sincerely,

Dr. Tre Pennie Candidate
Candidate for U.S. Congress
Texas Congressional District 3

Friend,
I believe deeply in our democratic institutions, that Americans are entitled to free and fair elections, and that every vote matters.
When we show up, we have the power to incite change.
In 2010, when I was first elected, Colorado was a true battleground state. Today, we have two Democratic senators, five Democratic Congresspeople, a Democratic governor, and a majority in the Colorado General Assembly.
That didn’t happen because of luck or coincidence. It happened because of the sustained, hard work of community organizers, and because of Coloradans who spoke up for their own best interest at the ballot box.
Every vote made a difference.
Next year, we have a chance to flip Colorado’s Third Congressional District blue and take back the House majority.
Rep. Lauren Boebert only won her race by a margin of 546 votes in 2022. In office, she has repeatedly failed her constituents. She voted against clean energy projects, reproductive rights, and good-paying jobs for her district.
Friend, the Colorado Democratic Party has created The 546 Project to flip CO-03 blue. With your grassroots support, they can invest in field organizers, reach voters, and mobilize the vote on Election Day.
Every dollar makes a difference. Will you split a donation now between my campaign and the Colorado Democratic Party so we can elect pro-democracy, pro-choice leaders in our state? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cdp-bennet?refcode=X_111523_CDPBennet_act]

Derek,

I’m proud of the many hats I’ve worn: a third-generation military veteran, an engineer, an entrepreneur, a high school chemistry teacher, and a nonprofit leader. **But more than any other, I’m proud of the time that I’ve served as your****representative to Congress. **

By sticking to the facts and collaborating with colleagues on both sides of the aisle, I’ve been able to secure investments in our local economy, stand up for women’s reproductive rights, protect veterans’ health care in our region, and fight back against extremism. We’ve also helped constituents resolve frustrating issues with the IRS and passports, track down lost mail, and get home after being stuck overseas.

First, after 22 days without a Speaker and four nominees, House Republicans finally elected their new leader, Mike Johnson.

Though my colleagues across the aisle pat themselves on the back for this “accomplishment,” the truth is no one should be celebrating.

When we were in the majority, House Democrats led two of the most productive sessions of Congress in recent history. Since the GOP has taken the gavel, though, they’ve shown they’re committed to prioritizing partisan politics and Constitutional chaos.

You and I are both ready to see a change of pace in D.C., and we can achieve that by reclaiming the House majority in 2024. Peter, I need your help.
